before_state.title: PDA-01: Platform Design Assistant shell + Propose tab
before_state.description:
## Scope

Add **Propose** mode to Platform Catalog shell (mode title `DESIGN ASSISTANT`) with deterministic proposal engine.

## Status

**Done in App Builder demo shell** (2026-08-04). Production Unity host remains PDA-04.

## Acceptance

- [X] Tabs: Catalog | Import | Propose
- [X] Mode title DESIGN ASSISTANT when Propose active
- [X] Generate proposal from name/domain/side/role/concept
- [X] Peer basis + field basis table shown
- [X] Outlier warnings vs domain stats

## Artifacts

* Notion Spec: [https://app.notion.com/p/3b2f7cb4e4df81adae9fefcbc239825c](<https://app.notion.com/p/3b2f7cb4e4df81adae9fefcbc239825c>)
* Notion Skill Pack: [https://app.notion.com/p/3b2f7cb4e4df8190b548e320a1881e37](<https://app.notion.com/p/3b2f7cb4e4df8190b548e320a1881e37>)

## Verified Trunk Cross-References (origin/main)

* Note: The 2026-08-04 App Builder demo shell is historical; its production C# counterparts (`PlatformDesignAssistantBridge`, `PlatformDesignAssistant`, CLI/MCP propose) merged to `origin/main` via PR `#399` (`59424c7d`), PR `#444` (`24494d39`), and R1-R3 closeout `42ab0bff`.
* Git source of truth: `docs/engineering/platform-design-assistant.md`
* Production C# bridge: `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Bridge/PlatformDesignAssistantBridge.cs`

before_state.title: PDA-02: Skill pack — catalog-grounding + relative-scaling
before_state.description:
## Skills

Implement skill contracts:

1. catalog-grounding
2. archetype-schema
3. relative-scaling (light/standard/heavy)
4. provenance tagging
5. gate-policy (extend-only new ids)
6. workbook-emit (DiffRow\[\])
7. what-if flag

## Acceptance

- [ ] Peer score ranks same-domain higher
- [ ] Role weight shifts numeric fields toward min/mid/max
- [ ] Collision id suffix uniqueness
- [ ] Provenance docId = assistant

## Notion

Skill Pack page under cmano-clone hub.

## Verified Trunk Cross-References (origin/main)

* Note: The 2026-08-04 App Builder JS skill-pack prototype is historical; the production C# grounding, relative-scaling, provenance, and workbook-emit contracts merged to `origin/main` via PR `#399` (`59424c7d`), PR `#444` (`24494d39`), and PR `#867` (`c908f12b`).
* Git source of truth: `docs/engineering/platform-design-assistant.md`

before_state.title: PDA-03: Handoff Design Assistant → Import staging → Approve
before_state.description:
## Flow

Generate proposal → **Send to Import staging** → auto-stage DiffRows → Ack → Approve (CatalogWriteGate).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Import source label shows Design Assistant · {name}
- [ ] Pending count updates on shell health strip
- [ ] Preview in Catalog inserts draft only (not committed until Approve)
- [ ] Bridge-down still blocks Propose/Approve

## Depends on

PDA-01, PDA-02

## Verified Trunk Cross-References (origin/main)

* Note: The 2026-08-04 App Builder JS demo handoff is historical; production C# staging/approve integration via `CatalogWriteGate` merged to `origin/main` in PR `#75` (`266a78c7`), PR `#80` (`c9302a72`), PR `#215` (`c0028ca5`), PR `#217` (`c82f3bec`), PR `#218` (`955aecb3`), PR `#399` (`59424c7d`), PR `#444` (`24494d39`), and PR `#867` (`c908f12b`).
* Git source of truth: `src/ProjectAegis.Data/WriteGate/CatalogWriteGate.cs`
* Production C# assistant: `src/ProjectAegis.Data/PlatformAssistant/PlatformDesignAssistant.cs`

before_state.title: Combat event projection contract
before_state.description:
## Goal

Define the deterministic, presentation-facing event contract for player-visible engagements.

## Acceptance criteria

* Emits intent accepted, authorization/refusal, firing/launch, sustained or in-flight state where applicable, and terminal outcome.
* Includes shooter, target, weapon family, outcome, correlation ID, simulation time, and explanation reference.
* Remains replay-stable and is the only combat-fact source for presentation.
* Consumes the authoritative Slice A targetability state and does not rebuild existing sensor, weapon-envelope, or datalink overlays.

## Dependency

Follows the Slice A kill-chain foundation and targetability scenario.

## Design

Notion: Combat Interaction UX — Proposed Requirements and Vertical Slice.

* Uses real projections; no presentation-only combat truth.

Follows the Slice A targetability scenario and the combat event projection contract.

Create one deterministic scenario proving one missile, one gun, and one laser engagement from command through outcome.

## Acceptance criteria

* Covers permitted and refused engagement states.
* Correlates map rendering, event log, and replay for each engagement.
* Checks tactical and operational zoom behavior and non-color-only recognition.
* Uses real projections; no presentation-only combat truth.

## Dependency

Follows the Slice A targetability scenario and the combat event projection contract.

## Design

Notion: Combat Interaction UX — Proposed Requirements and Vertical Slice.

## Goal

Make escorting, sectors, shared targeting, and group-level combat intent visible and controllable.

## Acceptance criteria

* Shows responsibility boundaries and group-to-unit command effects.
* Explains when coordination or delegation prevents an action.
* Preserves the established command and projection boundaries.

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** parent epic [DRG-185](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-185>); related layered defense [DRG-192](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-192>), authority [DRG-182](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-182>)/[DRG-209](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-209>).
* **Decision needed (CMANO):** AC is not testable as written; which coordination types (escort, sector, shared targeting) are in the first cut and what 'controllable' means are product scope choices.

* Includes a valid and an invalid or approval-required target path.

* Supplies replay-stable acceptance evidence for the Slice A exit gate.

PR <pull-request id="74e9633e-e213-482f-8881-7cd558764ea5" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#682" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/drg-183-slice-a-targetability-scenario-and-acceptance-harness-3de6cdfe5f28" /> head43b67ee0074f6bb4c152894a9534adcae256ace5 reviewed in isolated clean worktree. Valid path + approval-required alternative meets the issue's stated headless alternative; deterministic production projections over declared synthetic fixture input, no live sensing or owner interaction claimed. ## Goal

Let players inspect a mission package’s coverage, gaps, commitments, and the consequence of moving or losing an element.

## Acceptance criteria

* Shows coverage and unprotected areas at an appropriate map scale.
* Explains the change in defense or mission posture caused by reassignment or loss.
* Honors authority and delegation boundaries.

## Requirement source

Notion: IBCS-Informed Combat C2 Framework — IBCS-08.

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** parent epic [DRG-185](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-185>); requirement IBCS-08 (Notion); related [DRG-175](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-175>).
* **Decision needed (CMANO):** 'appropriate map scale' and what counts as a coverage gap need product definition before AC can be testable.

* Exercise empty, stale, unknown and comms-loss states using grounded inputs.
* Controls remain reachable at baseline 1600x979 and 1280x779 and supported UI scale extremes; include keyboard and pointer checks distinct from callback automation.
* Reuse <issue id="7565c7a4-b3ff-4d35-aaea-4ff7f56452bd" label="DRG-170" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-170/validate-combat-declutter-accessibility-and-replay" />/177/205 for accessibility, declutter, replay and usability evidence.
* Preserve <issue id="0381b880-6dcf-4bbf-8a9d-2207f67d280a" label="DRG-185" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-185/epic-slice-c-command-learn-adapt" />/175/192 ownership of positive group/BDA and live coverage gaps. Fixtures are explicitly labeled and cannot be reported as live-scenario proof.
* Each failure links to a requirement and existing owner or a newly justified defect.

## Dependencies and boundaries

G1 baseline first. GitNexus <issue id="72627172-94af-41de-b160-61e0febb7890" label="DRG-197" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-197/reindex-gitnexus-and-verify-the-post-implementation-knowledge-graph" /> recovery before any symbol edits. Reuse current projection/command boundaries; DelegationBridge remains untouched. Owner acceptance is separate from technical smoke.

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

Record commit, scenario/catalog/policy, seed, input steps, expected/actual behavior, screenshots and linked failures. Prove actual live-source composition before calling a result live; otherwise label it as a fixture. <issue id="bbd11124-fd93-497b-8619-9c8fb864d9e6" label="DRG-414" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-414/expose-production-fire-controlshooterauthority-facts-so-the-slice-a" />/417 remain dependencies for their specific production-fed claims.

before_state.description:
Architect intake 2026-09-13. Merge of CORE-01 + lane C2-23 + Notion C2-07 (campaign membership).

**User story:** As a theater commander, I want to browse and load a packaged scenario from Play Mode (with campaign membership and pre-load feasibility) so Phase 1 of the core loop is real.

**Requirement:** REQ-02 / LOOP-01 · REQ-20 CMD-27 · CMD-27.12 campaign membership

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] From Play Mode, player can list package scenarios with title + theater + mode hints
- [ ] Selecting a scenario loads policy + ORBAT and lands in Planning with Begin Execution available
- [ ] Failed resolve (`dbRef` / validation) shows a non-mutating error; sim does not tick
- [ ] Briefing shows campaign membership without filename encoding
- [ ] Pre-load feasibility / validation summary visible before commit
- [ ] Headless or PlayMode smoke: load → Planning → Begin Execution once

**Out of scope:** Mission Editor authoring (G3 / AUTH-01); replacing DRG-208 signoff.

Surface: Play Mode / scenario library (play path, not editor).

## Delivery preflight — 2026-10-01

Current source1902dc12: library browse/preview has no load/commit control or policy/ORBAT handoff; default ReloadFromDisk omits catalog/validation dependencies. Compose validated canonical document+resolved catalog/policy+ORBAT+seed+campaign membership into a non-mutating load contract, then bind existing library and initialize Planning. Keep automatic smoke ticking outside product entry; Begin Execution once through approved facade. Missing/changed document, explicitdbRef failure and blocking validation preserve prior session/no tick. Source/evidence and bounded cases in docs/superpowers/reviews/2026-10-01-play-entry-fixture-preflight.md. Retains DRG197 blocker; no implementation or owner signoff. Unity8080 unavailable for captures.

**User story:** As the human signoff owner, I want DRG-208 to link a single evidence index (Slice B/C packages, G gates, symbology) so acceptance is auditable.

**Requirement:** REQ-20

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Description checklist of required evidence links (B, C, G2 path, symbology if ready)
- [ ] Separates technical smoke vs owner acceptance
- [ ] Lists known unverified rows (live group scenario until HYG-05)

**Out of scope:** Performing the human signoff itself.

## Auditable evidence index — 2026-09-22

Documentation assembled for target `da6c5c64d0181238931002de4a3f6cf763137c88`. Required link checklist:

- [X] Slice B implementation/verification package linked; historical headless evidence and outstanding visual acceptance distinguished.
- [X] Slice C implementation and Play Mode package linked; retained raw JSON confirms 6 passing historical Unity leaf tests (1 + 4 + 1), not discovery-node totals.
- [X] G1 → G2 path and G3 boundaries linked; expected G1 baseline path returned 404 at target.
- [X] Symbology requirements linked and marked not ready; no implementation or acceptance claimed.
- [X] Known unverified rows listed, including positive live group/BDA and live coverage until <issue id="311294ec-2133-439e-90e8-e3c65394762e" label="DRG-239" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-239/hyg-05-author-smoke-scene-task-group-coverage-for-play-mode-acceptance" />/HYG-05 evidence exists.
- [X] Technical smoke, callback/fixture evidence, owner acceptance, delivery status and capture provenance separated.

<issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" />–170 currently read Todo despite <issue id="9737363c-65d0-4590-adb5-b27fee67da94" label="DRG-240" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-240/hyg-01-reconcile-slice-b-linear-states-to-in-review" />'s historical In Review statement; the index preserves the discrepancy. <issue id="066c5b74-3cec-4f52-9eba-4ef15653abab" label="DRG-208" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208/play-human-play-mode-re-signoff-at-da6c5c64" />'s target-revision human acceptance remains pending. The Windows OpenRouter credential was located. Jev consultation is pending explicit approval to disclose the private evidence summary to OpenRouter after automatic approval review rejected execution; no inference request or Jev recommendation is claimed. Owner: drg amtd. <issue id="066c5b74-3cec-4f52-9eba-4ef15653abab" label="DRG-208" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208/play-human-play-mode-re-signoff-at-1902dc12" /> now targets `1902dc1299678ea17f75014406fd9c616e5576bd` as reported by the live Linear integration waterline. Architect ACCEPT. REQ-04 Override & Intervention.

**User story:** As a player, I want to seize, pause, and return a delegated unit from the unit panel.

## AC

- [ ] Take control yields agent immediately; unit shows Human; group member detaches per locked decision
- [ ] Pause suspends intents without clearing tasking; Resume restores
- [ ] Return to agent rejoins/resumes; order-log ControllerChange
- [ ] Disabled under AttachReplayViewer with reason

**Depends on:** DEL-01 badge refresh.

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

First-package control-handoff lane. Reuse delivered controller badges/initial assignment; do not rebuild them.

Acceptance refinement:

* Exactly one active controller after take/return; rejected or repeated commands cannot duplicate orders or log events.
* Distinguish agent pause from simulation pause and from taking direct control.
* Inspect and prove the existing suspension/resume/task-retention seam first. If absent, scope a domain-command dependency; UI state must not become controller authority.
* Verify group detach/rejoin, retained tasking and pending-human-order behavior.
* Replay/observer refuses mutations.
* Register all supported handoff commands with the <issue id="d224a671-afb7-4ea8-bf7e-84279249c710" label="DRG-348" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348/h6-save-contract-define-complete-same-buildcatalog-save-resume-state" /> input-journal inventory.

Candidate read anchors: DelegationOrchestrator.cs, Controllers/ControllerSlot.cs, bridge public take/release APIs; candidate UI anchor: unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/RightUnitPanelHost.cs. These are not a Surface stamp. Runtime remains Backlog; GitNexus unavailable while the development laptop is offline.

Architect ACCEPT. REQ-04 Override & Intervention.

**User story:** As a player, I want to seize, pause, and return a delegated unit from the unit panel.

## AC

- [ ] Take control yields agent immediately; unit shows Human; group member detaches per locked decision
- [ ] Pause suspends intents without clearing tasking; Resume restores
- [ ] Return to agent rejoins/resumes; order-log ControllerChange
- [ ] Disabled under AttachReplayViewer with reason

**Depends on:** DEL-01 badge refresh.

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

First-package control-handoff lane. Reuse delivered controller badges/initial assignment; do not rebuild them.

Acceptance refinement:

* Exactly one active controller after take/return; rejected or repeated commands cannot duplicate orders or log events.
* Distinguish agent pause from simulation pause and from taking direct control.
* Inspect and prove the existing suspension/resume/task-retention seam first. If absent, scope a domain-command dependency; UI state must not become controller authority.
* Verify group detach/rejoin, retained tasking and pending-human-order behavior.
* Replay/observer refuses mutations.
* Register all supported handoff commands with the <issue id="d224a671-afb7-4ea8-bf7e-84279249c710" label="DRG-348" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348/h6-save-contract-define-complete-same-buildcatalog-save-resume-state" /> input-journal inventory.

Candidate read anchors: DelegationOrchestrator.cs, Controllers/ControllerSlot.cs, bridge public take/release APIs; candidate UI anchor: unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/RightUnitPanelHost.cs. These are not a Surface stamp. Runtime remains Backlog; GitNexus unavailable while the development laptop is offline.

before_state.description:
Architect ACCEPT. Remap of Notion C2-04. No prior Linear title.

**User story:** As a player, I want a pending-approval interrupt that forces 1× and shows DLZ window countdown.

## AC

- [ ] Approval-required interrupt forces 1×
- [ ] DLZ countdown visible during interrupt
- [ ] Cancel/confirm through command façade

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

Pending approvals use <issue id="846392f4-6766-4374-9fb5-77017fcfadb0" label="DRG-408" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-408/per-category-message-log-notification-policy-log-pause-map-balloon" />'s shared attention/time-command coordinator. Package-level direction is approved by this conversation; the existing hold label is retained until the concrete scoped implementation is reconciled with that hold.

Acceptance refinement:

* One approval event issues at most one 1x request.
* Countdown is driven only by authoritative DLZ-window data; missing data is Unknown, not a timer inferred from animation.
* Confirm/cancel execute through the existing authority command boundary, preserve ordering, and revalidate stale/expired approvals.
* Replay/observer commands are disabled with an explicit reason.
* Include the command path in <issue id="d224a671-afb7-4ea8-bf7e-84279249c710" label="DRG-348" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348/h6-save-contract-define-complete-same-buildcatalog-save-resume-state" /> journal coverage.

No protected-method waiver or runtime implementation is claimed.

after_state.title: EPIC [H6] Save-Load / Multiplayer — scope intake
after_state.description:
## Context

**There is no game-state save/load on** `main`**.**

* `SimulationSession` (`src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Orchestration/SimulationSession.cs`, a frozen hub per `docs/architecture/adr-simulation-session-frozen-hub-spirit1-2026-06-20.md`) exposes Pause, Resume, `SetTimeAccelerationFactor` and Tick. It has no save or restore.
* `ReplayCheckpointStore` (`src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Replay/ReplayCheckpointStore.cs`) records only `(simTick, worldHash, logFingerprint, lastSequenceId)`. Those are hashes, not restorable state.
* The determinism contract (`docs/engineering/determinism-and-replay.md`, `src/ProjectAegis.Sim/Core/SimWorldHash.cs`, `SeededRng`) says `(scenario, seed)` must give an identical order log. That makes replay-to-tick a natural save model.
* The GDD already specifies it: `design/gdd/simulation-core-time.md` edge case "Save/load restores simTick, scenarioSeed, RNG stream counters (checkpoint + log tail)".
* Scenario *authoring* save/load exists (`ScenarioAuthoringSession`, ME-023, `SaveVsExportGateTests`). That is file authoring, not game state.

**Multiplayer is excluded from v1 in the repo:**

* `design/gdd/game-concept.md`: "Out (v1): … full multiplayer"
* `production/stage.txt`: "No E7/E9/multiplayer"
* `production/release/launch/faq-draft.md`: "Out of current E7 prep scope (ZERO DelegationBridge edits)"
* `unity/ProjectAegis/ProjectSettings/MultiplayerManager.asset` is only the Unity default.

**ZERO-touch wording:**

* `AGENTS.md`: "DelegationBridge.cs | Zero-touch through Release v1 — no hotpath changes" and "DelegationBridge hotpath | ZERO"
* `production/agentic/local-cloud-agent-routing.md`: "Zero-touch: DelegationBridge hotpath / SimulationSession unless product waiver."

## Entry gate

Product confirmation + an **ADR for the DelegationBridge ZERO-touch constraint** (roadmap §14). Roadmap 2026-08-09 also notes "out of single-player deploy model".

## Hard-no exposure (ADR required before touching)

* **DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath**: `Tick(ISimWorldSnapshot, IOrderSink)`, `TryEnqueueHumanOrder`, `TryIssuePlayerCommand`
* **SimulationSession**: clock, watch queue, orchestrator state
* **ReplayGolden**: any change to order-log or checkpoint schema (ADR-003) or to tick order. No silent re-bless.
* **CMD-31/32/34**: issued player commands must be persisted (save) or networked (multiplayer)
* **CatalogWriteGate**: a save must pin the catalog snapshot hash and never write
* **S122 / Launch**: multiplayer changes the product and deploy model
* Map hosts: loading a save into Play Mode rebinds `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` / `GlobeMapProductHost`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Product decision recorded: save-load only, or save-load + multiplayer (child story)
- [ ] ADR merged and Accepted. It must name either an explicit product waiver of ZERO-touch or a design that needs no bridge or session change.
- [ ] First slice defined with non-`TBD` Surfaces, and a replay-hash plan (preserve, or re-bless via ADR)

Target scope: `TBD` (scope intake only; dispatch surfaces assigned at sprint kickoff). Protected label `single-owner`: DelegationBridge and SimulationSession cluster.

## Start condition

**Nothing is started until the owner gives GO for H6.** This issue stays in Backlog: do not set it In Progress and do not dispatch agents.

Invariants unchanged: floor per `production/test-floor.json` · ReplayGolden 6/6 · hash `17144800277401907079` · DelegationBridge ZERO hotpath · CatalogWriteGate extend-only · Stage Release.

Source: `design/gdd/simulation-core-time.md`

before_state.title: [H6] Draft ADR: save/load + multiplayer vs DelegationBridge ZERO-touch constraint
before_state.description:
## Context

The H6 entry gate requires an ADR for the ZERO-touch constraint:

* `AGENTS.md`: "DelegationBridge.cs | Zero-touch through Release v1 — no hotpath changes"
* `production/agentic/local-cloud-agent-routing.md`: "Zero-touch: DelegationBridge hotpath / SimulationSession unless product waiver"

No game-state save/load exists today. `ReplayCheckpointStore` holds hashes only. `SimulationSession` is a frozen hub (`docs/architecture/adr-simulation-session-frozen-hub-spirit1-2026-06-20.md`).

## Scope of the ADR

Write a new ADR under `docs/architecture/` using the next free number. ADR-027 is taken by open PR <pull-request id="540d1213-7de1-4ff7-a462-c2a405c9d241" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#679" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsunity-record-unity-mcp-stack-choice-adr-027-and-fix-0860-version-176dd2257933" />, so check before numbering.

1. **Save model options**, compared:
   * (a) Replay-to-tick: persist scenario id + seed + catalog snapshot hash + human/player order log, then load by deterministic re-simulation
   * (b) Full state snapshot
   * (c) Hybrid: periodic state checkpoint + log tail, as the GDD `design/gdd/simulation-core-time.md` describes
2. **ZERO-touch analysis**: which option can run entirely *outside* `DelegationBridge.Tick` and the `SimulationSession` hotpath (for example, a new orchestration-level driver that replays orders through existing public APIs). Which one needs a product waiver, and exactly which methods it would touch.
3. **Determinism and ReplayGolden**: prove the Baltic v2 hash `17144800277401907079` and ReplayGolden 6/6 are unaffected, or state the re-bless plan under this ADR. **No silent re-bless.** Cover order-log schema impact (ADR-003) and the `SeededRng` / `SimWorldHash` contract (`docs/engineering/determinism-and-replay.md`).
4. **Multiplayer section**, scoped by the product decision (<issue id="bd666834-41d3-4329-b768-035ac588db6f" label="DRG-328" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-328/h6-product-decision-save-load-only-vs-multiplayer-for-h6" />): lockstep over the same order log vs server-authoritative, and why either touches `TryEnqueueHumanOrder` / `TryIssuePlayerCommand` (CMD-31/32/34 seams).
5. **Catalog**: saves pin `CatalogSnapshotHasher` output and never write through `CatalogWriteGate`.
6. **Presentation**: how Play Mode rebinds after a load without editing `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` / `GlobeMapProductHost` (ADR-010 / 007 / 001 presentation wall).

## Entry gate

This story **is** the ADR half of the H6 gate. The owner can draft it before the product decision; it becomes Accepted only after <issue id="bd666834-41d3-4329-b768-035ac588db6f" label="DRG-328" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-328/h6-product-decision-save-load-only-vs-multiplayer-for-h6" /> is decided.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ADR file merged with Status Proposed, then Accepted by the owner
- [ ] Each option lists touched symbols, or states that none are touched
- [ ] Explicit statement: product waiver granted or not required
- [ ] Replay-hash plan stated
- [ ] First implementation slice named, with a non-`TBD` Surface

Surface: `docs/architecture/adr-0NN-*.md` (docs-only; zero `src/` or `unity/` edits)

## Start condition

**Nothing is started until the owner gives GO for H6.** This issue stays in Backlog and no agent is dispatched.

2026-09-30 recommendation adopted as planning direction: same-build/catalog save first, multiplayer separate and later. <issue id="d224a671-afb7-4ea8-bf7e-84279249c710" label="DRG-348" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348/h6-save-contract-define-complete-same-buildcatalog-save-resume-state" /> defines complete authoritative state/compatibility before <issue id="acb8038b-874f-4d97-9005-499caaa1bb1a" label="DRG-349" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-349/h6-save-slice-prove-deterministic-same-build-save-and-resume-before" /> implementation; checkpoint hashes alone are insufficient. Manual/autosave/retention details and any zero-touch waiver remain unresolved. This is not acceptance of the ADR.

before_state.title: [H5] Draft content-pipeline / Addressables ADR
before_state.description:
## Context

The H5 entry gate is "Content pipeline ADR accepted". No such ADR exists (`docs/architecture/` holds ADR-001…026; ADR-027 is in open PR <pull-request id="540d1213-7de1-4ff7-a462-c2a405c9d241" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#679" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsunity-record-unity-mcp-stack-choice-adr-027-and-fix-0860-version-176dd2257933" />).

Addressables use today is a single atlas key, `Map/App6FrameAtlas`:

* `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Addressables/Map/App6AtlasAddressablesManifest.json`
* `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/App6AddressablesGroupSetup.cs`
* `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/App6AddressablesCatalog.cs`
* Consumed by `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` with a Unicode fallback (S27-07)

The package is `com.unity.addressables` 2.9.1. The roadmap (`docs/reports/future-sprint-roadmap-07142026.md`) lists "Addressables / remote content design undesigned".

## Scope of the ADR

Write a new ADR under `docs/architecture/` using the next free number.

1. **Content classes** in and out of Addressables:
   * Presentation art/USS/audio (`production/assets/*`, `design/assets/asset-manifest.md`)
   * APP-6 atlases
   * Globe/basemap tiles
   * Scenario packages (`AegisScenarioPackage`)
   * Catalog snapshots (`src/ProjectAegis.Data/Snapshots/`)

   Core sim DLLs are **out** (`.claude/agents/unity-addressables-specialist.md`).
2. **Presentation wall** (ADR-010 / 007 / 001): Addressables APIs only in Unity presentation assemblies. `ProjectAegis.Sim`, `ProjectAegis.Data` and `ProjectAegis.Delegation` keep headless resolvers like `App6AddressablesCatalog` and never reference `UnityEngine.AddressableAssets`.
3. **Determinism**: sim-relevant data (catalog, scenario policy) must reach the sim through existing Data loaders and hashes (`CatalogSnapshotHasher`, `UnifiedReleaseTrainManifest`), not through Addressables. State how the Baltic hash `17144800277401907079` stays preserved. **No silent ReplayGolden re-bless.**
4. **CatalogWriteGate**: Addressables never becomes a write path into the catalog.
5. **Host impact**: bulk loading must go through a new loader seam, not by growing `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` or `GlobeMapProductHost`. If it cannot, name the waiver.
6. **Local vs remote**: local-only for Release, or remote/CDN (Launch-adjacent, and H3 is not open).
7. Build and CI: headless CI cannot build Addressables content, so say what is verified headless and what needs a local Editor.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ADR file merged with Status Proposed, then Accepted by the owner (this closes the H5 gate)
- [ ] Content-class table with owner and loader for each class
- [ ] Hard-no impact stated per host, gate and golden
- [ ] First slice named, with a non-`TBD` Surface

Surface: `docs/architecture/adr-0NN-content-pipeline-addressables.md` (docs-only)

## Start condition

**Nothing is started until the owner gives GO for H5.** This issue stays in Backlog and no agent is dispatched.

2026-09-30 planning direction authorized by user: local presentation-only pilot first (<issue id="d37c71b0-abcf-43e4-844f-8f7b545a0ffd" label="DRG-347" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-347/h5-pilot-local-presentation-content-loading-with-deterministic-failure" />), with loading failure isolation and authoritative replay invariants. Inventory <issue id="e3383353-b551-45de-807d-60a52efe11ad" label="DRG-332" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-332/h5-content-inventory-classify-addressables-candidates-vs-sim-relevant" /> gates this ADR. Package/version and lifetime decision remain Proposed until reviewed; remote delivery/DLC/catalog behavior is excluded.

The H5 entry gate is "Content pipeline ADR accepted". No such ADR exists (`docs/architecture/` holds ADR-001…026; ADR-027 is in open PR <pull-request id="540d1213-7de1-4ff7-a462-c2a405c9d241" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#679" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsunity-record-unity-mcp-stack-choice-adr-027-and-fix-0860-version-176dd2257933" />).

Addressables use today is a single atlas key, `Map/App6FrameAtlas`:

* `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Addressables/Map/App6AtlasAddressablesManifest.json`
* `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/App6AddressablesGroupSetup.cs`
* `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/App6AddressablesCatalog.cs`
* Consumed by `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` with a Unicode fallback (S27-07)

The package is `com.unity.addressables` 2.9.1. The roadmap (`docs/reports/future-sprint-roadmap-07142026.md`) lists "Addressables / remote content design undesigned".

## Scope of the ADR

Write a new ADR under `docs/architecture/` using the next free number.

1. **Content classes** in and out of Addressables:
   * Presentation art/USS/audio (`production/assets/*`, `design/assets/asset-manifest.md`)
   * APP-6 atlases
   * Globe/basemap tiles
   * Scenario packages (`AegisScenarioPackage`)
   * Catalog snapshots (`src/ProjectAegis.Data/Snapshots/`)

   Core sim DLLs are **out** (`.claude/agents/unity-addressables-specialist.md`).
2. **Presentation wall** (ADR-010 / 007 / 001): Addressables APIs only in Unity presentation assemblies. `ProjectAegis.Sim`, `ProjectAegis.Data` and `ProjectAegis.Delegation` keep headless resolvers like `App6AddressablesCatalog` and never reference `UnityEngine.AddressableAssets`.
3. **Determinism**: sim-relevant data (catalog, scenario policy) must reach the sim through existing Data loaders and hashes (`CatalogSnapshotHasher`, `UnifiedReleaseTrainManifest`), not through Addressables. State how the Baltic hash `17144800277401907079` stays preserved. **No silent ReplayGolden re-bless.**
4. **CatalogWriteGate**: Addressables never becomes a write path into the catalog.
5. **Host impact**: bulk loading must go through a new loader seam, not by growing `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` or `GlobeMapProductHost`. If it cannot, name the waiver.
6. **Local vs remote**: local-only for Release, or remote/CDN (Launch-adjacent, and H3 is not open).
7. Build and CI: headless CI cannot build Addressables content, so say what is verified headless and what needs a local Editor.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ADR file merged with Status Proposed, then Accepted by the owner (this closes the H5 gate)
- [ ] Content-class table with owner and loader for each class
- [ ] Hard-no impact stated per host, gate and golden
- [ ] First slice named, with a non-`TBD` Surface

Surface: `docs/architecture/adr-0NN-content-pipeline-addressables.md` (docs-only)

## Start condition

**Nothing is started until the owner gives GO for H5.** This issue stays in Backlog and no agent is dispatched.

2026-09-30 planning direction authorized by user: local presentation-only pilot first (<issue id="d37c71b0-abcf-43e4-844f-8f7b545a0ffd" label="DRG-347" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-347/h5-pilot-local-presentation-content-loading-with-deterministic-failure" />), with loading failure isolation and authoritative replay invariants. Inventory <issue id="e3383353-b551-45de-807d-60a52efe11ad" label="DRG-332" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-332/h5-content-inventory-classify-addressables-candidates-vs-sim-relevant" /> gates this ADR. Package/version and lifetime decision remain Proposed until reviewed; remote delivery/DLC/catalog behavior is excluded.

before_state.description:
Owner: drg amtd. Proposed RPL-29–31. Save first is the authorized planning direction; multiplayer separate and later. This item does not approve a save ADR.

## Save/resume delivery alignment — 2026-10-30

Follow [DRG-348's contract draft](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df81f59f6afed203c1d04f?pvs=204>) and the [command-experience delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Existing dependency relations are retained.

Extend the proof matrix beyond final-world hashes: compare journal order/results, log sequence/content and replay fingerprints at restoration and future boundaries. Include at least three interruption points (before approval, with a delayed order, during engagement/resource change), accelerated clocks, same-tick inputs, traits/rebrief, control handoff, pending salvo overrides, and unknown/omitted journal commands. Validate build/catalog/scenario identity and full catalog coverage. Rejection, cancellation and failed writes must preserve the active session or previous save slot as applicable.

Restore into an isolated world/snapshot/order-sink/bridge candidate, verify replay, then swap consistently and expose the paused session. Share the existing stepper; do not fork RunCore or assume ReplayCheckpointStore can hydrate. Journal the new alert-policy/control/doctrine commands when introduced. Optional external-provider replay must use captured inputs rather than live calls.

No runtime implementation, tests, performance result, owner acceptance or protected-method waiver is claimed. Development laptop is offline; required GitNexus impact is unavailable. Keep Backlog until the contract and execution prerequisites are satisfied.

Runtime implementation follows approved contract and GitNexus impact analysis; DelegationBridge zero-touch invariant preserved.

## Save/resume delivery alignment — 2026-10-30

Follow [DRG-348's contract draft](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df81f59f6afed203c1d04f?pvs=204>) and the [command-experience delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Existing dependency relations are retained.

Extend the proof matrix beyond final-world hashes: compare journal order/results, log sequence/content and replay fingerprints at restoration and future boundaries. Include at least three interruption points (before approval, with a delayed order, during engagement/resource change), accelerated clocks, same-tick inputs, traits/rebrief, control handoff, pending salvo overrides, and unknown/omitted journal commands. Validate build/catalog/scenario identity and full catalog coverage. Rejection, cancellation and failed writes must preserve the active session or previous save slot as applicable.

Restore into an isolated world/snapshot/order-sink/bridge candidate, verify replay, then swap consistently and expose the paused session. Share the existing stepper; do not fork RunCore or assume ReplayCheckpointStore can hydrate. Journal the new alert-policy/control/doctrine commands when introduced. Optional external-provider replay must use captured inputs rather than live calls.

No runtime implementation, tests, performance result, owner acceptance or protected-method waiver is claimed. Development laptop is offline; required GitNexus impact is unavailable. Keep Backlog until the contract and execution prerequisites are satisfied.

before_state.title: DRG-183 follow-up: exercise production composition path in Slice A targetability acceptance
before_state.description:
## Context

Deferred from Codex P2 on [PR #682](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/682#discussion_r4162412266>) (<issue id="16808b76-bda9-456a-83ec-91657f67eaa2" label="DRG-183" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-183/build-slice-a-targetability-scenario-and-acceptance-harness" /> Slice A targetability harness).

## Suggestion

The acceptance harness builds a fresh `DecisionLog`, appends only fixture-authored contact changes, and invokes read-only projectors — so zero engagement/order/magazine/ordnance counts are true by construction. Codex wants the harness to drive the fixture through the production headless/session or Slice A composition path and inspect the authoritative log before asserting the advertised “without firing” condition.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for <pull-request id="74e9633e-e213-482f-8881-7cd558764ea5" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#682" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/drg-183-slice-a-targetability-scenario-and-acceptance-harness-3de6cdfe5f28" />)

<issue id="16808b76-bda9-456a-83ec-91657f67eaa2" label="DRG-183" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-183/build-slice-a-targetability-scenario-and-acceptance-harness" /> acceptance is explicitly headless projection evidence over a checked-in fixture (valid + approval-required paths, provenance/authority/ROE, replay-stable fingerprint off Baltic v2). Owner LGTM and G1 harness review already accepted that design. Expanding into live session composition would widen Surface beyond the stamped three test-only files and is out of scope for this land wave.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Drive fixture through the production headless composition path (not a fresh empty DecisionLog alone).
* Assert zero fire/ordnance from the authoritative log after that path.
* Keep Baltic v2 / ReplayGolden untouched; stay off production hotpath unless a separate story owns it.

Surface: `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/TargetabilityAccept/**`

before_state.description:
## Context

Deferred from Codex P1 on [PR #683](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/683#discussion_r4162411970>) (<issue id="5ac73570-f572-45f1-bc7b-013650ad64ed" label="DRG-258" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-258/c2-01-weapon-abort-tooltip-top-3-fireabortreason" /> weapon abort tooltip).

## Suggestion

Codex claims `VisualElement.tooltip` is Editor-only and that denied weapon rows never show abort reasons at runtime without a `TooltipEvent` handler or custom popup.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for <pull-request id="02016151-53ae-41dd-80ad-670161762666" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#683" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featui-drg-258-weapon-abort-tooltip-04b102b898f5" /> land)

The same host already assigns `button.tooltip` for <issue id="edefdae9-4a5b-49dc-ba94-cc0d4a461203" label="DRG-262" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-262/c2-05-attack-options-menu-preview-parity" /> attack-menu options; <issue id="5ac73570-f572-45f1-bc7b-013650ad64ed" label="DRG-258" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-258/c2-01-weapon-abort-tooltip-top-3-fireabortreason" /> reuses that UITK path on focusable weapon rows. Owner LGTM accepted the binder + row chrome. Play Mode visibility is the existing human gate <issue id="066c5b74-3cec-4f52-9eba-4ef15653abab" label="DRG-208" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208/play-human-play-mode-re-signoff-at-1902dc12" />, not a Surface-widening popup rewrite in this land wave.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* In Play Mode, confirm hover/focus on a denied fire row shows the abort tooltip text.
* If UITK default tooltips do not appear under the game PanelSettings, add a small runtime tooltip presenter (TooltipEvent / popup) shared with attack-button tooltips — keep ADR-010 presentation-only.

before_state.title: DRG-258 follow-up: scope weapon-abort tooltip combat detail to selected unit
before_state.description:
## Context

Deferred from Codex P2 on [PR #683](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/683#discussion_r4162411977>) (<issue id="5ac73570-f572-45f1-bc7b-013650ad64ed" label="DRG-258" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-258/c2-01-weapon-abort-tooltip-top-3-fireabortreason" /> weapon abort tooltip).

## Suggestion

`ProjectCombatDetail()` can resolve an explicit combat-history inspection key before the selected unit. Passing that into the live weapon-abort binder may mix unrelated historical abort codes with the selected unit's current explain; top-3 by enum priority can then displace the real denial.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for <pull-request id="02016151-53ae-41dd-80ad-670161762666" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#683" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featui-drg-258-weapon-abort-tooltip-04b102b898f5" /> land)

Clear engage explain already suppresses historical combat-detail reasons. Edge case only when inspecting history while another unit stays command-selected. Stamped Surface stays the six <issue id="5ac73570-f572-45f1-bc7b-013650ad64ed" label="DRG-258" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-258/c2-01-weapon-abort-tooltip-top-3-fireabortreason" /> files; widening selection scoping is a follow-up.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Bind weapon-abort tooltip from combat detail scoped to the selected unit / current engagement, not the global inspection key.
* Keep presentation-only (no new sim queries); stay inside RightUnitPanelHost + binder Surface.

Surface: `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Presentation/WeaponAbortTooltipBinder.cs`, `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter.Tests/Presentation/WeaponAbortTooltip*Tests.cs`, `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/RightUnitPanelHost.cs`

before_state.title: DRG-169 follow-up: reject cross-snapshot target mismatches on contact combat card
before_state.description:
## Context

Deferred from Codex P2 on [PR #684](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/684#discussion_r4162526546>) (<issue id="56453500-7b38-4684-afaa-376904a68c1c" label="DRG-169" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-169/add-contact-combat-card-and-bda-state" /> headless contact combat card).

## Suggestion

When snapshots associate the same contact ID with different targets (e.g. provenance maps `c1` to `target-1` while targetability or BDA maps it to `target-2`), `ResolveEngagementTargetId` suppresses only the engagement, but targetability and BDA for `target-2` can still render on `c1`'s card. Fail those fields closed to `UNKNOWN` unless their target agrees with the selected contact's other identity facts.

## Scope

`ContactCombatCardProjection.cs` (+ tests). Non-blocking for the <pull-request id="bf3faee0-81f0-4709-99fc-8c1ad2cfdf8f" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#684" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/drg-169-headless-contact-combat-card-projection-and-bda-state-a5b527a2c57b" /> land; mixed-frame / contact-ID reuse edge case.

Deferred from Codex P2 on [PR #684](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/684#discussion_r4162526546>) (<issue id="56453500-7b38-4684-afaa-376904a68c1c" label="DRG-169" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-169/add-contact-combat-card-and-bda-state" /> headless contact combat card).

## Suggestion

When snapshots associate the same contact ID with different targets (e.g. provenance maps `c1` to `target-1` while targetability or BDA maps it to `target-2`), `ResolveEngagementTargetId` suppresses only the engagement, but targetability and BDA for `target-2` can still render on `c1`'s card. Fail those fields closed to `UNKNOWN` unless their target agrees with the selected contact's other identity facts.

## Scope

`ContactCombatCardProjection.cs` (+ tests). Non-blocking for the <pull-request id="bf3faee0-81f0-4709-99fc-8c1ad2cfdf8f" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#684" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/drg-169-headless-contact-combat-card-projection-and-bda-state-a5b527a2c57b" /> land; mixed-frame / contact-ID reuse edge case.

before_state.title: DRG-165 follow-up: wire Slice A targetability into production CombatPresentationFrame.Build; match targetability on shooter + target
before_state.description:
## Context

Deferred code-review findings on [PR #696](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/696>) (<issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" /> combat event contract consumes Slice A targetability + execution facts), plus a matching finding on [PR #702](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/702>) (<issue id="28e8db3d-4595-4bbb-ba4d-c38283aa6261" label="DRG-166" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-166/combat-vertical-slice-scenario-and-acceptance-harness" /> vertical-slice harness).

## Findings

1. `CombatPresentationFrame.cs:79` **— Slice A link exists only in tests.** The bridge and `SliceBCombatScenario` call `Build` without Slice A targetability, so the targetability → combat-event link DRG-165 advertises is only exercised by unit tests, never on the production/scenario path.
2. `CombatEventProjection.cs:240` **— targetability lookup matches target only.** It should also match the requested shooter; otherwise a targetability fact for a different shooter on the same target can be attached to the event.
3. **Same pattern in PR #702:** `EngagementExplanationProjection.cs:90` uses a target-only lookup, so an earlier refusal can show later (or other-shooter) facts.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #696 / #702)

The PRs land the headless contract and harness; changing the bridge/scenario composition widens Surface beyond the stamped presentation files. The lookup fixes are correctness hardening with no current production consumer depending on multi-shooter disambiguation.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Bridge and `SliceBCombatScenario` pass the authoritative Slice A targetability state into `CombatPresentationFrame.Build`; a scenario-level test (not a hand-built frame) proves the link appears.
* `CombatEventProjection` targetability lookup keys on (shooter, target) \[and correlation/time where applicable\]; test with two shooters on one target proves the correct fact is attached.
* `EngagementExplanationProjection` lookup keys on shooter + target and respects ledger/sim-time order so an earlier refusal never shows later facts; regression test included.
* Replay-stable; ReplayGolden / Baltic v2 hash untouched; `DelegationBridge` hotpath unchanged unless a separate single-owner story owns it.

Surface (CMANO re-stamp 2026-10-29, main 3bcfbb7b): `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Baltic/CombatVerticalSliceHarness.cs`, `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Baltic/SliceBCombatScenario.cs` (only if the scenario `Result` must carry the targetability frame), `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter.Tests/Baltic/CombatVerticalSliceHarnessTests.cs`. All three exist on main 3bcfbb7b; none is hard-no.

Dependency cleared: PR <pull-request id="7cb3625f-5a34-475a-99d8-8786ce00096d" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#710" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/fixcombat-preserve-shooter-scoped-slice-a-facts-65e19ccd2f6f" /> (`fix(combat): preserve shooter-scoped Slice A facts`) merged into `main` 2026-10-15 (merge commit 7674649f, an ancestor of 3bcfbb7b). It covered findings 1, 2 and 3 (runtime bridge plus shooter + target lookups). This story is the residual scenario path: on 3bcfbb7b `CombatVerticalSliceHarness.cs:97` still passes `SliceAContactFrame.Empty` into `CombatPresentationFrameBridge.Build`; pass a frame carrying the authoritative targetability built at line 95, plus a scenario-level test (not a hand-built frame) proving the link appears in `slice.Frame.Events.Targetability`.

Read-only, do not edit (landed via <pull-request id="7cb3625f-5a34-475a-99d8-8786ce00096d" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#710" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/fixcombat-preserve-shooter-scoped-slice-a-facts-65e19ccd2f6f" />, now on main): `CombatPresentationFrame.cs`, `SliceAContactFrame.cs`, `CombatEventProjection.cs`, `CombatEventLogProjection.cs`, `CombatEventFingerprint.cs`, `CombatEventTypes.cs`, `EngagementExplanationProjection.cs`, `TargetabilityAcceptProjection.cs` and their tests. Not touched: `DelegationBridgeHost.cs`, `SimulationSession.cs` (used, not edited), ReplayGolden / Baltic v2 hash. Open gap outside this Surface: on 3bcfbb7b `EngagementExplanationProjection.FindTargetability` is shooter + target scoped but has no sim-time ordering, so <pull-request id="7cb3625f-5a34-475a-99d8-8786ce00096d" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#710" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/fixcombat-preserve-shooter-scoped-slice-a-facts-65e19ccd2f6f" /> did not cover the sim-time acceptance bullet. Track that in a separate follow-up; do not widen this Surface.

Owner lane: SliceA. Not reserved.

## Context

Deferred code-review findings on [PR #699](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/699>) (S124 pre-commit constraint/cost strip + refuse bark with ADR-010 fence; <issue id="c7df88ed-b9f5-41af-bb45-8d7c04e606f1" label="DRG-356" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-356/s124-01-w2-c2-01-pre-commit-constraint-cost-strip" /> S124-01, <issue id="0041b3f7-208a-4861-93f9-30d7fbe4ac0a" label="DRG-358" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-358/s124-03-w2-c2-04-refusedrop-bark-log-reason" /> S124-03).

## Findings

1. `CommitConstraintStripBinder` **/** `CommitRefusalBarkBinder` **are not wired to the live commit UI.** Both binders are headless/static; no Unity host binds them (suggested UXML names in the PR: `commit-strip-constraints`, `commit-strip-cost`, `commit-bark-line`).
2. `CommitRefusalBarkBinder.cs:170` **— two DROPPED barks for one refusal.** `SimulationSession` emits a `PolicyDenialRecord` *plus* a synthetic not-launched `EngagementRecord` for the same denied order, so the binder produces two DROPPED barks. Coalesce them into one.
3. `CommitRefusalBarkBinder.cs:125` **— bark shows** `UNSPECIFIED` **but the log line is blank.** When the abort code falls back, put the same fallback code in the `MessageLogLine` so bark and log agree.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #699)

(1) is deferred by design — #699 is a headless PR; Unity host wiring and Editor screenshots are explicitly out of scope. (2)/(3) only surface once a host renders barks; no live consumer yet.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Strip and bark render in the live commit UI via the existing presentation host; projection-only fence (`CommitStripProjectionFenceTests`) stays green; plugin DLL refreshed; Editor capture recorded.
* One denied order yields exactly one DROPPED bark (correlated `PolicyDenialRecord` + synthetic not-launched `EngagementRecord` coalesced); regression test.
* Fallback abort code (e.g. `UNSPECIFIED`) appears in both bark and log line; regression test.
* Façade remains authoritative; no `SimulationSession` / order-sink / `DelegationBridge` edits from presentation.

before_state.description:
## Context

Deferred code-review finding on [PR #698](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/698>) (<issue id="044990c3-0fab-4227-988a-c3ca7af56e6f" label="DRG-345" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-345/h4-capability-expose-unsupported-mission-roles-before-export-and-play" /> disclose unexecuted mission roles before Export and Play). Related: <issue id="5f3fde68-82d5-4309-8b80-1254f1308065" label="DRG-346" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-346/h4-first-slice-map-edit-validate-save-export-play-using-existing" /> H4 first slice.

## Finding

`MissionRoleCapabilityManifest.cs:103` **labels Patrol/Strike as executed**, but `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` never passes missions to `BalticReplayHarness.Run`. On the CLI simulate path, Patrol/Strike missions are therefore effectively generic (units behave without mission-specific execution), so the manifest overstates execution.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #698)

The obvious fix — marking Patrol/Strike unexecuted at **Error** severity — would block Export of every Patrol/Strike scenario, which is worse than the current overstatement. The right fix needs a new intermediate tier, which is a contract change beyond #698's scope.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Manifest gains a **generic-only** tier evaluated per execution backend (CLI simulate vs session/Play), surfaced as a **Warning** finding with a stable code.
* Patrol/Strike on the CLI simulate path produce the generic-only Warning; Export and Play are **not** blocked; Tanker/AEW/EW unexecuted Errors unchanged.
* Disclosure text in validation UI/briefing states the role runs as generic behavior on that backend; UI does not invent sim authority.
* Deterministic role-policy fixtures + UI projection tests cover executed / generic-only / unexecuted; saving incomplete drafts still allowed.
* If `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` is later changed to pass missions, the tier flips to executed via the manifest (no hard-coded role lists in UI). ReplayGolden hash untouched.

before_state.title: Wire ControllerBadgeProjection into AgentRosterPanelHost.Refresh (make DRG-252 badges player-visible)
before_state.description:
Follow-up deferred from [PR #705](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/705>) (DRG-252), review thread PRRT_kwDOSqtCp86pw34J.

`ControllerBadgeProjection` is currently used only in its definition and tests. `AgentRosterPanelHost.Refresh()` (`unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/AgentRosterPanelHost.cs:205-217`) still binds `bridgeHost.LastAgentRoster` only through `AgentRosterApplyState.Apply`.

**This is the item that makes the DRG-252 controller badges visible to players.**

## Acceptance

* `AgentRosterPanelHost.Refresh` binds the `ControllerBadgeProjection` output (shape, text, color, accessibility) into OOB roster rows.
* Badge updates after assign / suspend / take-control / return-to-agent, with no sim mutation from the UI.
* Binder or smoke test asserts roster → badge binding on the runtime path.

Surface: `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/AgentRosterPanelHost.cs`, `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/AgentRosterApplyState.cs` (add the badge to `AgentRosterDisplayRow` by mapping `ControllerBadgeProjection.FromRosterEntry`), `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/UI/AgentRoster/AgentRosterPanel.uss` (badge shape / colour-token classes), `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Projection/AgentRosterBadgeApplyTests.cs` (new).

Scope notes: `AgentRosterPanelHost.Refresh()` binds the badge's shape, short text, colour token and accessible label into the roster `ListView` rows (`makeItem` / `bindItem`). Shape and text carry state, so colour is never the only channel. The badge updates from `LastAgentRoster` after assign / suspend / take-control / return-to-agent with no sim mutation. Don't add a second badge binder class. The OOB tree and map binding belong to DRG-374.

Read-only, do not edit: `ControllerBadgeProjection.cs`. Not touched (DRG-374): `MapPlaceholderPanelHost.cs`, `OobTreePanelHost.cs`, `ControllerBadgeBinder*.cs`. Also not touched: `GlobeMapProductHost.cs`, `DelegationBridgeHost.cs`. * Coalesced notifications retain event identity and reasons.

before_state.title: Source MessageLogProjection combat lines from the CombatEvent contract, not the decision log
before_state.description:
## Problem

`MessageLogProjection` still builds its launch, abort, and outcome lines straight from the order/decision log (`OrderLogEntryKind.Engagement` / `EngagementOutcome` payloads). It does not read the <issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" /> `CombatEvent` contract. That leaves the message log as a second combat-fact path, which breaks <issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" />'s rule that combat events are the only combat-fact source for presentation.

## Evidence

* `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/MessageLogProjection.cs` on main: lines \~47–61 switch on `EngagementOutcomeRecord` / `EngagementRecord` ("Unit … launched engagement …", "Engagement aborted: {AbortReasonCode}"), and `ProjectCombatOutcome` (\~175–211) formats Kill/Intercept/Hit/Miss directly.
* Consumers: `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Bridge/MessageLogBridge.cs` (`MessageLogProjection.Project(log)` and `Project(bridge.GetLiveOrderLogView())`).
* PR [drgaciw/cmano-clone#696](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featcombat-drg-165-combat-event-contract-consumes-slice-a-04ba3acac253>) (<issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" />) fixed only `CombatPresentationFrameBridge` (see `docs/superpowers/reviews/2026-10-06-drg-165-combat-event-contract-audit.md`). It did not touch `MessageLogProjection`. PR [drgaciw/cmano-clone#700](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/fixcombat-card-drg-353354355-contact-card-hardening-drg-322-attack-283b8d44d493>) also did not touch it.
* Overlap: the abort/refusal wording here overlaps <issue id="4d622922-9423-4af4-aa9b-1aff30bf0146" label="DRG-168" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168/build-engagement-explanation-surface" /> refusal text. Agree on one refusal-text source before changing either. Related: <issue id="741eb9d4-8afc-499f-a722-1cfde01cae70" label="DRG-376" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-376/bind-live-hud-to-messagelogbridgeprojectlive-delegationbridgehostcs649" /> (live HUD binding to `MessageLogBridge.ProjectLive`).

before_state.title: CombatVfxProjection runs every tick but its frame is never rendered (dead path)
before_state.description:
## Problem

`DelegationBridgeHost` calls `CombatVfxProjection.Project(DecisionLog, LastMapSymbols, SimTime)` on every tick and stores the result in `LastCombatVfx`. Nothing renders that frame. The work costs time on every tick, and it is also another decision-log combat-fact path outside the `CombatEvent` contract.

## Evidence

* `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/DelegationBridgeHost.cs` \~L666: `LastCombatVfx = CombatVfxProjection.Project(...)`.
* The only runtime reader is `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/MapPlaceholderPanelHost.cs` (\~L489/L507). It uses `LastCombatVfx` only as a dirty-check reference. `ApplyTransientCombatVfx()` (\~L357) draws through `_combatView.Bind(DisplayCombatFrame, …)`, not the VFX frame.
* `MapCanvasTransientEffectsRenderer.Sync(CombatVfxFrame)` exists, but GitHub code search finds no runtime code that creates it or calls it. Only its contract tests use it.
* Neither PR [drgaciw/cmano-clone#696](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featcombat-drg-165-combat-event-contract-consumes-slice-a-04ba3acac253>) (<issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" />) nor PR [drgaciw/cmano-clone#700](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/fixcombat-card-drg-353354355-contact-card-hardening-drg-322-attack-283b8d44d493>) touched these files.

## Acceptance criteria

* Make a decision: either remove `CombatVfxProjection` and `MapCanvasTransientEffectsRenderer` from the tick path, or wire them in properly, sourced from `CombatEventSnapshot`.
* If removed: the dirty check in `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` keys off the combat frame it actually renders. Dead tests and docs (`docs/engineering/combat-vfx-projection.md`) are updated.
* No per-tick projection runs without a consumer.
* Replay goldens and PlayMode smoke stay green.

Source: Project Aegis room 2026-10-07 (SliceB/SliceC/Hygiene)

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

**Surface (CMANO 2026-10-14, main 254d2c96):** `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/DelegationBridgeHost.cs` (only `LastCombatVfx` property L92 and the `CombatVfxProjection.Project` call \~L666), `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/MapPlaceholderPanelHost.cs` (only the `LastCombatVfx` dirty-check refs \~L586/L604), `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/CombatVfxProjection.cs`, `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Projection/CombatVfxProjectionTests.cs`, `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/MapCanvasTransientEffectsRenderer.cs`, `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter.Tests/Map/MapCanvasTransientEffectsRendererContractTests.cs`, `docs/engineering/combat-vfx-projection.md`.

before_state.title: SkillEnvelopeValidator.Validate has no production caller — wire it in or remove it
before_state.description:
## Problem

`SkillEnvelopeValidator.Validate(SkillEnvelope, bool proposalApproved)` is public and tested, but no production code calls it. Production code reuses only its reason-code constants. Either the skill-envelope check is never enforced at runtime, or the method is dead code.

## Evidence

* `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Skills/SkillEnvelopeValidator.cs` (L31, `Validate`).
* GitHub code search for `SkillEnvelopeValidator` on main finds only tests (`src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Skills/SkillEnvelopeValidatorTests.cs`), docs/contract files (`production/docs/skills/agent-c2-skill-contract/*`, `docs/engineering/c2-authority-escalation-chrome.md`), and `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Skills/C2AuthorityProjector.cs`. `C2AuthorityProjector` references only the `Reason*` constants (L15–17) and never calls `Validate`.
* `production/qa/drg-197-gitnexus-reindex-evidence.md` (<issue id="72627172-94af-41de-b160-61e0febb7890" label="DRG-197" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-197/reindex-gitnexus-and-verify-the-post-implementation-knowledge-graph" />, PR <pull-request id="6557634e-7317-47ec-9c33-b2e9d8669d2a" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#681" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/drg-197-gitnexus-reindex-verify-evidence-at-7a097f93-737a691527e4" />): the GitNexus query for the envelope validator returned 0 processes.

## Acceptance criteria

* Make a decision, written down: either wire `Validate` into the production skill/engage command path, or remove it and move the constants somewhere else.
* If wired in: a production caller exists, a test proves a rejected envelope is blocked, and the skill contract doc is updated.
* If removed: the tests and the contract docs (`CONTRACT.md`, `PROOF.md`, `verify-contract.ps1`) are updated, and the build is green.

Source: Project Aegis room 2026-10-07 (SliceB/SliceC/Hygiene)

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

before_state.description:
## Problem

The message log has no per-category notification policy. In CMO, each message type (new contact, weapon launch, weapon endgame, unit lost, fuel, etc.) can be set to: show in the log, raise a pop-up that pauses the sim, show a balloon on the map at the subject, and drop time compression to 1x. Without this, a player running at high time compression can miss a hostile launch or a lost unit until well after it happens. Aegis has pause and acceleration (<issue id="33bfdfcc-aeed-49b3-b9a5-e2dd6df86193" label="DRG-14" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause" />) and a message log (<issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" />), but nothing links log categories to attention or time-control behavior.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual, Game Options → Message Log: per message type, "Show on Message Log", "Raise Pop-Up" (pauses the game), "Show Balloon" (on the map at the subject's location), and "Timescale X1" (drop from acceleration to 1x). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/>)
* CMO manual §3.1.7: the log is split into categories that can be minimized or emphasized, so routine messages don't bury critical ones. Hovering a message highlights its subject on the map. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* Player feedback asks for exactly this per-type control, including keeping time running while still being notified. [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/](<https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" /> covers click → unit deep-link, and <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> covers sourcing combat lines from CombatEvent. Neither covers category policy or time-control escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageCategoryPolicy` projection maps each message category to {Log, Pause, Balloon, DropToRealTime}. Defaults are data-driven, not hardcoded.
* When a matching message arrives, the projection emits an attention intent. Pause and 1x requests go through the existing command/time façade as player-visible requests. The projection never calls sim internals directly, and the change does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath or SimulationSession.
* The UI binds only to the projection. A settings panel edits the policy, and balloon markers anchor to the message subject.
* Replay is deterministic: under AttachReplayViewer, policy-driven pauses are suppressed or reported but never change the order log.
* Tests cover the default mapping, a user override, and the no-op under replay.

Source: Projects Manager web research 2026-10-07

## Problem

The message log has no per-category notification policy. In CMO, each message type (new contact, weapon launch, weapon endgame, unit lost, fuel, etc.) can be set to: show in the log, raise a pop-up that pauses the sim, show a balloon on the map at the subject, and drop time compression to 1x. Without this, a player running at high time compression can miss a hostile launch or a lost unit until well after it happens. Aegis has pause and acceleration (<issue id="33bfdfcc-aeed-49b3-b9a5-e2dd6df86193" label="DRG-14" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause" />) and a message log (<issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" />), but nothing links log categories to attention or time-control behavior.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual, Game Options → Message Log: per message type, "Show on Message Log", "Raise Pop-Up" (pauses the game), "Show Balloon" (on the map at the subject's location), and "Timescale X1" (drop from acceleration to 1x). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/>)
* CMO manual §3.1.7: the log is split into categories that can be minimized or emphasized, so routine messages don't bury critical ones. Hovering a message highlights its subject on the map. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* Player feedback asks for exactly this per-type control, including keeping time running while still being notified. [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/](<https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" /> covers click → unit deep-link, and <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> covers sourcing combat lines from CombatEvent. Neither covers category policy or time-control escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageCategoryPolicy` projection maps each message category to {Log, Pause, Balloon, DropToRealTime}. Defaults are data-driven, not hardcoded.
* When a matching message arrives, the projection emits an attention intent. Pause and 1x requests go through the existing command/time façade as player-visible requests. The projection never calls sim internals directly, and the change does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath or SimulationSession.
* The UI binds only to the projection. A settings panel edits the policy, and balloon markers anchor to the message subject.
* Replay is deterministic: under AttachReplayViewer, policy-driven pauses are suppressed or reported but never change the order log.
* Tests cover the default mapping, a user override, and the no-op under replay.

before_state.title: Show doctrine/ROE/WRA inheritance source and effective value per unit, with reset-to-inherited
before_state.description:
## Problem

Authority and ROE state is projected (<issue id="09fd8608-86ec-4243-888d-7dd0f126a8d2" label="DRG-182" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-182/project-command-authority-and-rules-of-engagement-state" />, <issue id="62f19a5c-38c2-44cb-ad50-c2e2ba23b291" label="DRG-209" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-209/slice-a-headless-authority-and-roe-projection" />), and WRA salvo-remaining shows on weapon chrome (<issue id="b052e2f4-59ae-43a4-850f-ae28460de62f" label="DRG-259" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-259/c2-02-wra-salvo-remaining-on-weapon-chrome" />). But the player cannot see *where* a unit's effective doctrine, ROE, or WRA value comes from (side, mission, group, or unit override), or reset an override back to inherited. In CMO this inheritance view is the main way a player finds out why a unit held fire or fired unexpectedly.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual §3.3.12: every doctrine option has an "inherited" setting. A unit follows its side's doctrine, or its mission's doctrine if assigned to one, and buttons reset it to the inherited default. Doctrine, EMCON, and WRA are separate tabs. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* CMO manual §6.3.8: side doctrine/ROE/WRA is set at the top level and "flows down to mission and then groups/units". The WRA tab lists every weapon the side uses. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/drop-down-menus/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="9cb22a1c-4d7a-499d-ba6d-44462898cedd" label="DRG-321" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-321/jev-vs3-roe-noul-facade-accept-coordinationcommandbridge" /> (ROE Noul + façade Accept) is about AI-assisted ROE suggestions, not showing inheritance. No issue covers per-level provenance or reset.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `DoctrineInheritanceProjection` gives, for each selected unit and each doctrine/ROE/WRA field: the effective value, the source level (Side/Mission/Group/Unit), and the overridden parent value if there is one.
* Reset-to-inherited is sent as a command through the command façade and recorded in the order log. It is never a UI-side state mutation.
* The unit panel shows an override marker and a source badge for each field, and the WRA rows show target-type × quantity × range using the existing <issue id="b052e2f4-59ae-43a4-850f-ae28460de62f" label="DRG-259" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-259/c2-02-wra-salvo-remaining-on-weapon-chrome" /> chrome.
* The engagement explanation (<issue id="4d622922-9423-4af4-aa9b-1aff30bf0146" label="DRG-168" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168/build-engagement-explanation-surface" />) can cite the doctrine source level when doctrine is the refusal reason.
* Tests cover inherited, mission-overridden, and unit-overridden fields, and the reset round-trip under replay.

Source: Projects Manager web research 2026-10-07

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** authority/ROE projections [DRG-182](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-182>), [DRG-209](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-209>); WRA chrome [DRG-259](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-259>); explanation [DRG-168](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168>) (C2 guide in <pull-request id="b80cd6c2-4f2a-4e86-b255-054abcbe5ec6" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#759" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsc2-reconcile-both-documentation-stacks-and-canonical-guides-e1c12e5af761" />); not a duplicate of [DRG-321](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-321>). ADR-010 command façade.
* **Dependencies:** <issue id="62f19a5c-38c2-44cb-ad50-c2e2ba23b291" label="DRG-209" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-209/slice-a-headless-authority-and-roe-projection" /> (Slice C must not edit Skills/ until it lands).
* **Fences (from rubric H3/H5):** headless projection first; source-fence test (no UnityEngine/MonoBehaviour/ApplyOrder/DecisionLog write/SimulationSession/DelegationBridge refs); replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged, no ReplayGolden re-bless; any visible UI change gets a named [DRG-208](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208>) Play Mode walk item (human gate).

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

Source correction: DoctrineInheritanceProjection already exists. Extend it and its binder/tests; do not introduce a duplicate projection.

At main 570a7f84, ScenarioPolicyProfile.ResolveUnitPolicy resolves unit override, then mission, then friendly/opposing default. The existing projection carries a single source label; this is not proof of a complete per-field Side/Mission/Group/Unit cascade.

Acceptance refinement:

* Each supported displayed source/effective value matches the authoritative resolver.
* Unsupported source levels/fields are explicit; do not invent Group inheritance.
* Reset-to-inherited requires a real domain command, resulting-policy validation and replayable evidence. No direct UI dictionary mutation.
* Extend current explanation wording to cite the same authoritative source.
* Journal any new reset command under <issue id="d224a671-afb7-4ea8-bf7e-84279249c710" label="DRG-348" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348/h6-save-contract-define-complete-same-buildcatalog-save-resume-state" />.

Candidate files and source links are in the delivery plan. Runtime remains Backlog pending impact/scope; no tests or UI acceptance claimed.
