## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### AGD-04 — Four Autonomy Levels with ROE/Policy Gate and Lethal Opt-In (lines 32-39)

Implement four autonomy levels (Manual, Assisted, SemiAutonomous, FullAutonomous) integrated with ROE/policy evaluation (AutonomyGate + RoePolicyAdapter), requiring explicit player opt-in per mission phase for full-autonomous lethal engagement.

- [ ] \[AGD-04\] AutonomyLevel defines Manual, Assisted, SemiAutonomous, and FullAutonomous tiers gated by AutonomyGate and IRoeFilter.
- [ ] \[AGD-04\] Full autonomous lethal engagement enforces explicit player opt-in per mission phase (aligned with PendingApprovalQueue / HOL).

### AGD-07 — Realistic Variability via Deterministic Trait-Weighted Softmax DecisionPipeline (lines 60-63)

Exhibit human-like decision variability (mistakes, hesitation, personality styles). DecisionPipeline softmax (Decisiveness), SeededRng, SlowerReactions (ReactionDelay\*5), and NarrowedFocus (Take(2)) are shipped, while ErrorRate, Aggression, and RiskTolerance candidate scoring remain unwired across DecisionPipeline and IPolicy implementations.

- [ ] \[AGD-07\] DecisionPipeline selects among candidate actions deterministically using SeededRng given identical seed, traits, candidates, and attention state.
- [ ] \[AGD-07\] ErrorRate (occasional mistakes), Aggression, and RiskTolerance drive candidate scoring and personality-specific decision styles in IPolicy/DecisionPipeline rather than remaining unwired.

### AGD-09 — Agent Delegation Responsiveness, Logging, and ROE Compliance NFRs (lines 69-75)

Ensure delegation remains responsive at thousands of entities without performance degradation, logs 100% of agent decisions for replay, and strictly respects ROE and player-defined constraints.

- [ ] \[AGD-09\] All agent intents pass through AutonomyGate and IRoeFilter before execution.
- [ ] \[AGD-09\] Delegation tick overhead remains bounded as entity count scales.

### AGD-11 — Agent Attention and Bandwidth Model with Graceful Degradation (lines 136-144)

Enforce per-agent attention budget (default 20, personality-modulated) scaling load by contacts/engagements/groups and degrading overloaded decisions. AttentionCalculator, SlowerReactions, and NarrowedFocus + IsOverloaded temperature scaling are shipped, while SimplerDecisions (>1.5x budget) is UI-only and overload integration tests are missing.

- [ ] \[AGD-11\] AttentionCalculator computes load from contacts, engagements, and group members against personality-modulated budget (default 20), with SlowerReactions and NarrowedFocus active.
- [ ] \[AGD-11\] SimplerDecisions drives simpler decision behavior in AgentController/DecisionPipeline (beyond UI projection) and overload degradation is covered by integration tests beyond AttentionCalculator.Evaluate.

### AGD-14 — Delegation Comms Degradation and Attention Coupling (lines 106-106)

Integrate CommsTimelineSimulator order delays and stale/datalink flags into agent observations and reduce effective attention budget under degraded comms (Phase 2), with EW Specialist preset balancing comms/EMCON tradeoffs.

- [ ] \[AGD-14\] Agents observe stale/datalink status flags from comms timelines without breaking determinism.
- [ ] \[AGD-14\] Degraded comms modulates effective attention budget per doc 19 integration.

- [ ] \[ROE-01\] Parent policy edits support designer choice to cascade to or lock child overrides.

MaxSalvo enforcement and UI binder exist, while per-weapon/mount/range/target-category WRA tables remain unmodeled.

- [ ] \[ROE-04\] WRA max salvo limits block excess rounds (e.g., max salvo 2 blocks a 3-round salvo) with FireAbortReason.WraSalvo and display remaining salvo allowance in UI.

### ROE-05 — EMCON per emitter class and mission EMCON schedules (lines 85-90)

Model per-emitter EMCON states (off, passive, active) across radar, sonar, ESM, datalink, and OECM affecting detection and enemy ESM, plus P1 mission-level EMCON schedules. Radar EMCON gating and HUD projection exist, while multi-emitter class inheritance and scheduled transitions remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[ROE-05\] EMCON passive or off on an emitter class prevents active emissions (such as active radar illumination) while allowing passive ESM reception and citing EMCON on fire abort.
- [ ] \[ROE-05\] Per-emitter EMCON controls cover radar, sonar, ESM, datalink, and OECM, and mission schedules transition EMCON deterministically at mission waypoints/phases.

### ROE-06 — Doctrine behavioral rules, withdraw/redeploy, posture, and special actions (lines 91-95)

Support mission doctrine (ignore course, opportunity targets, refuel/UNREP, withdraw on damage/ammo/bingo, nuclear gating) plus side posture and special-action gates. Damage-withdraw gates and assisted confirm UI exist, while full behavioral doctrine, fuel/ammo withdraw destinations, posture transitions, and nuclear/special gates remain open.

- [ ] \[ROE-06\] Exceeding configured damage, magazine, or bingo-fuel withdraw thresholds triggers a deterministic withdraw/redeploy decision or Assisted player confirmation prompt.
- [ ] \[ROE-06\] Ignore plotted course, engage opportunity targets, refuel/UNREP doctrine, hostile/neutral/friendly posture, and scenario-gated nuclear/special actions are enforced deterministically.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### SEN-TRACK-FIELDS — Contact multi-sensor sourceSensorIds\[\] provenance and position uncertainty representation (lines 44-67)

Extend contact records with multi-sensor provenance (sourceSensorIds\[\] listing all contributing sensors) and position uncertainty (ellipse/covariance, simplified to radius for MVP UI) plus contactId, observer sideId, lastUpdatedSimTick, and stale flag. ContactTransition, ContactChangeRecord, and ContactProvenance currently capture single SourceRef/ObserverId only.

- [ ] \[SEN-TRACK-FIELDS\] Each contact exposes sourceSensorIds\[\] enumerating all contributing sensors for multi-sensor provenance explainability.
- [ ] \[SEN-TRACK-FIELDS\] Each contact carries deterministic position uncertainty (ellipse/covariance model, simplified to uncertainty radius for MVP UI).

### SEN-EW-01 — EW deception (MVP range-gate noise), passive ESM emitter linking, EwSpecialist weighting, and EW-state rationale (lines 95-112)

Implement P0 and agent EW beyond noise jamming (SEN-04): P0 range-gate deception/false targets, P0 passive ESM emitter detection linking to contacts, EwSpecialist jamming-vs-kinetic weighting, and P0 agent EW-state rationale citation. SensorModality lacks ESM, EwSpecialist lacks jamming weighting, and deception and EW-state rationale remain open.

- [ ] \[SEN-EW-01\] Deterministic deception / range-gate noise degrades target range/track fidelity in MVP scenarios (full false-target synthesis P1).
- [ ] \[SEN-EW-01\] Passive ESM detects hostile emitters and links bearing/emitter returns to contacts without enabling active own-ship radar.
- [ ] \[SEN-EW-01\] Electronic Warfare Specialist (EwSpecialist) personality dynamically weights jamming actions vs kinetic fires during decision scoring.
- [ ] \[SEN-EW-01\] Agents cite active EW state in DecisionRecord/AgentDecisionPayload rationale when EW conditions block or alter firing.

### SEN-05 — Datalink side-picture merge, share lag, and CEC composite picture (lines 89-94)

Share tracks across side members via datalink doctrine with configurable lag and degraded-comms behavior, plus Doc 22 CEC composite track netting (SWARM-31). DatalinkSidePictureMerger, DatalinkShareLagResolver, and CecRemoteEngageGate exist, while full degraded-comms fidelity and conflicting-position merge rules remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[SEN-05\] Datalink sharing propagates contacts deterministically with configured share lag and halts or degrades when comms are denied.
- [ ] \[SEN-05\] Multi-sensor track merges resolve conflicting position estimates deterministically with recorded provenance.

### SEN-FOG — Fog of War modes (Full picture, Side realistic, Delegation blind) and briefing label (lines 113-123)

Configure scenario Fog of War mode (Full picture, Side realistic, Delegation blind) controlling player vs agent contact visibility and clearly labeling active fog mode in briefing/HUD. PlayerInfoModel and FogModeLabelBinder exist, while full organic-range player hiding and DelegationBlind divergence remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[SEN-FOG\] Player fog hides unidentified contacts beyond organic/configured datalink range under Side realistic and Delegation blind modes.
- [ ] \[SEN-FOG\] Briefing and C2 top-bar chrome clearly display the active scenario fog mode.

CommsTimelineSimulator, CommsState, and replay tests step scenario-wide transitions, while datalink track merger, per-link dropRate/delayMs/trackAgeMaxSec, and jamming cause remain open.

- [ ] \[COM-01\] CommsTimelineSimulator emits CommsStateChangeRecord entries at configured scenario ticks in deterministic order across Nominal, Degraded, and Denied (shipped spine).

- [ ] \[COM-03\] Degraded comms divisor accelerates contact stale-to-lost transitions deterministically in PdDetectionContactSimulator

- [ ] \[COM-03\] Partial-picture missing-contact subset behavior works cleanly across player and agent views (open residual)

### COM-04 — Comms display, top-bar status & C2 projection (lines 108-112)

- [ ] \[COM-04\] Contact list clearly distinguishes stale/datalink vs organic contacts and briefing supports configurable cyber spoiler levels (open residual)

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### COM-01 — Scenario-driven comms state machine (`Nominal` / `Degraded` / `Denied`) (lines 31-49)

Scenario policy-driven comms state machine (Nominal/Degraded/Denied), tactical datalink track-sharing lag/merger state (doc 15), and link degradation metadata (delayMs, dropRate, trackAgeMaxSec, Jamming cause). CommsTimelineSimulator, CommsState, and replay tests step scenario-wide transitions, while datalink track merger, per-link dropRate/delayMs/trackAgeMaxSec, and jamming cause remain open.

- [ ] \[COM-01\] CommsTimelineSimulator emits CommsStateChangeRecord entries at configured scenario ticks in deterministic order across Nominal, Degraded, and Denied (shipped spine).
- [ ] \[COM-01\] Tactical datalink track-sharing lag and merger state (doc 15) propagate and merge contacts deterministically under degraded comms.
- [ ] \[COM-01\] Link-level degradation parameters (dropRate: 0.05, delayMs: 800, trackAgeMaxSec: 120) and jamming-cause attribution (cause: { type: Jamming, sourceUnitId }) are modeled and logged deterministically.

### COM-03 — Track staleness & datalink lag under comms degradation (lines 55-56)

Track staleness acceleration and tactical datalink lag/partial-picture gating under comms degradation. Core staleness divisor, datalink share lag, and comms-grid rejoin reconciliation are implemented; partial-picture subset UX and full scenario staleness polish remain open.

- [ ] \[COM-03\] Degraded comms divisor accelerates contact stale-to-lost transitions deterministically in PdDetectionContactSimulator
- [ ] \[COM-03\] Datalink share lag and comms-grid rejoin reconciliation merge buffered observations deterministically without duplicate side-picture jumps
- [ ] \[COM-03\] Partial-picture missing-contact subset behavior works cleanly across player and agent views (open residual)

### COM-04 — Comms display, top-bar status & C2 projection (lines 108-112)

C2 comms display projection (`CommsStateProjection`, `commsDisplay` ghost offsets, top-bar status, message log `COMMS` entries, and contact list stale/datalink vs organic indicator).

- [ ] \[COM-04\] CommsStateProjection projects current CommsState and top-bar label (COMMS: DENIED/DEGRADED/NOMINAL) from DecisionLog
- [ ] \[COM-04\] MapPanelBinder renders ghost offsets under degraded comms per ScenarioCommsDisplaySettings
- [ ] \[COM-04\] Contact list clearly distinguishes stale/datalink vs organic contacts and briefing supports configurable cyber spoiler levels (open residual)

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### CMD-04 — Top bar: sim time, compression, pause, mode, Begin Execution (lines 77-77)

Top bar displays simulation time, time compression, pause/run state, simulation mode, comms legend, and Begin Execution transition. `C2TopBarProjection`, `C2TopBarPanelHost`, and `C2ClockCommand` exist on disk, while compression model disambiguation (multiplier vs time-per-step) and Editor acceptance remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-04\] Top bar displays formatted simulation time, phase, compression, mode, and comms state via C2TopBarProjection
- [ ] \[CMD-04\] Begin Execution transitions Planning to Executing cleanly and freezes planning-phase score counters prior to execution
- [ ] \[CMD-04\] Time compression model (multiplier vs time-per-step) explicitly standardized and Editor-verified (open residual)

### CMD-08 — Doctrine inheritance and effective policy panel (doc 13) (lines 81-81)

Doctrine panel displays effective ROE, salvo cap, EMCON, inheritance source chain (`unit -> embarked -> mission -> group -> side -> scenario`), and unit override control (`DoctrineInheritancePanelHost`, `DoctrineOverrideCommand`). Headless round-trip and UXML contract tests pass; Editor visual sign-off remains pending.

- [ ] \[CMD-08\] DoctrineInheritancePanelHost displays effective ROE, salvo, EMCON, and inheritance provenance for selected unit
- [ ] \[CMD-08\] Applying a doctrine override logs a PolicyUpdateRecord via DoctrineOverrideCommand and updates resolved effective policy
- [ ] \[CMD-08\] Editor visual acceptance recorded (pending)

### CMD-09 — Delegation badges and unit-level autonomy affordances (lines 82-82)

Unit-level delegation badge (`human` / `agent` / `mixed`), autonomy affordances, agent pause/resume, and OOB controller filters (`AgentRosterProjection`, `AgentRosterPanelHost`). Unit-granularity only (per-axis is `CMD-19`); side-level agent commander panel is Phase N.

- [ ] \[CMD-09\] Unit displays delegation badge with shape, short text, color token, and accessible label indicating human/agent/suspended state
- [ ] \[CMD-09\] Pausing or taking direct control suspends agent intent generation for that unit via C2PlayerCommandBridge
- [ ] \[CMD-09\] OOB filters support filtering human-controlled vs agent-controlled units (open residual)

### CMD-16 — Persistent unit-order toolbar (lines 89-89)

Persistent unit-order toolbar exposing order verbs for the current selection without requiring right-click context menus. Note: Doc 20 marks this Open ('no host'), whereas `UnitOrderToolbarHost`, `UnitOrderToolbarPanel.uxml/.uss`, and `UnitOrderToolbarLayoutTests` exist on disk (Wave 1); full verb parity and Editor sign-off remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-16\] UnitOrderToolbarHost renders core unit order verbs for the active selection and dispatches through C2PlayerCommandBridge
- [ ] \[CMD-16\] Every core unit order verb is reachable from the persistent toolbar as well as the context menu and verified in Editor

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### CMD-04 — Top bar: sim time, compression, pause, mode, Begin Execution (lines 77-77)

Top bar displays simulation time, time compression, pause/run state, simulation mode, comms legend, and Begin Execution transition. `C2TopBarProjection`, `C2TopBarPanelHost`, and `C2ClockCommand` exist on disk, while compression model disambiguation (multiplier vs time-per-step) and Editor acceptance remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-04\] Top bar displays formatted simulation time, phase, compression, mode, and comms state via C2TopBarProjection
- [ ] \[CMD-04\] Begin Execution transitions Planning to Executing cleanly and freezes planning-phase score counters prior to execution
- [ ] \[CMD-04\] Time compression model (multiplier vs time-per-step) explicitly standardized and Editor-verified (open residual)

### CMD-08 — Doctrine inheritance and effective policy panel (doc 13) (lines 81-81)

Doctrine panel displays effective ROE, salvo cap, EMCON, inheritance source chain (`unit -> embarked -> mission -> group -> side -> scenario`), and unit override control (`DoctrineInheritancePanelHost`, `DoctrineOverrideCommand`). Headless round-trip and UXML contract tests pass; Editor visual sign-off remains pending.

- [ ] \[CMD-08\] DoctrineInheritancePanelHost displays effective ROE, salvo, EMCON, and inheritance provenance for selected unit
- [ ] \[CMD-08\] Applying a doctrine override logs a PolicyUpdateRecord via DoctrineOverrideCommand and updates resolved effective policy
- [ ] \[CMD-08\] Editor visual acceptance recorded (pending)

### CMD-09 — Delegation badges and unit-level autonomy affordances (lines 82-82)

Unit-level delegation badge (`human` / `agent` / `mixed`), autonomy affordances, agent pause/resume, and OOB controller filters (`AgentRosterProjection`, `AgentRosterPanelHost`). Unit-granularity only (per-axis is `CMD-19`); side-level agent commander panel is Phase N.

- [ ] \[CMD-09\] Unit displays delegation badge with shape, short text, color token, and accessible label indicating human/agent/suspended state
- [ ] \[CMD-09\] Pausing or taking direct control suspends agent intent generation for that unit via C2PlayerCommandBridge
- [ ] \[CMD-09\] OOB filters support filtering human-controlled vs agent-controlled units (open residual)

### CMD-16 — Persistent unit-order toolbar (lines 89-89)

Persistent unit-order toolbar exposing order verbs for the current selection without requiring right-click context menus. Note: Doc 20 marks this Open ('no host'), whereas `UnitOrderToolbarHost`, `UnitOrderToolbarPanel.uxml/.uss`, and `UnitOrderToolbarLayoutTests` exist on disk (Wave 1); full verb parity and Editor sign-off remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-16\] UnitOrderToolbarHost renders core unit order verbs for the active selection and dispatches through C2PlayerCommandBridge
- [ ] \[CMD-16\] Every core unit order verb is reachable from the persistent toolbar as well as the context menu and verified in Editor

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### CMD-24 — Air Operations window (readiness, AIR_NOT_READY, loadout feasibility, tasking) (lines 151-160)

Air Operations window aggregates air assets by type/host, showing ReadyForLaunch with AIR_NOT_READY, magazine loadout feasibility, fuel, tasking, and time-to-ready/launch/abort/deck capacity. AirOpsFsm (LOG-08), AirOpsProjection, AirOpsReadyAggregateBinder, and AirOpsPanelHost exist (despite stale 'gated' note); deck/runway UX and Editor sign-off remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-24\] AirOpsProjection groups air assets by type/host, exposes ReadyForLaunch and AIR_NOT_READY refusal codes, and renders no unmodeled columns
- [ ] \[CMD-24\] Time-to-ready timers, launch/abort symmetry, and deck/hangar/runway capacity UX verified in Play Mode (open residual)

### CMD-27 — Scenario library and load operations (CMD-27.1..12: feasibility, provenance, determinism, campaigns) (lines 370-434)

Scenario library & pre-load screen (CMD-27.1..12): DB_MISMATCH/BROKEN_REF feasibility, provenance/trust, determinism meta, autosave/save/authored lists, search/filter, zero-state preview, Difficulty vs Complexity, scenario_export_brief, MapPictureProjection, campaigns. ScenarioLibrary\*/CampaignLibrary\* exist on disk; full filter/preview/campaign UX and Editor sign-off remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-27\] Library surfaces catalog resolution and validation errors on the entry row before load (CMD-27.1 / CMD-27.7)
- [ ] \[CMD-27\] Preview pane displays explicit zero-state instructions when nothing is selected and separates Difficulty from Complexity without color-only encoding (CMD-27.6 / CMD-27.8)
- [ ] \[CMD-27\] Campaign membership, sequence, and completion state persist as first-class metadata without filename encoding (CMD-27.12)

### CMD-28 — Menu system, basemap layer stack, view tools, and camera bookmarks (CMD-28.1..11) (lines 199-262)

Menu bar shortcuts (CMD-28.1), UI-local basemap stack (.2), view-vs-command boundary (.3), measure/grid (.4), unit cycling (.5), detach (.6), camera/window bindings (.7..9), 2D/3D (.10), bookmarks (.11), and map settings (20:36). C2Menu\*/MapLayerStack\*/MapMeasure\*/UnitCycle\* exist; detach, 2D/3D ADR-007 decision, map settings, and Editor sign-off remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-28\] View-state toggles (zoom, pan, basemap layers, grid, fullscreen) stay UI-local without polluting DecisionLog, while scenario/order actions preserve CLI/MCP parity
- [ ] \[CMD-28\] Primary view actions advertise both keyboard and pointer bindings in C2MenuProjection and empty camera bookmarks render enabled with explicit empty status text
- [ ] \[CMD-28\] Single-panel detachment (CMD-28.6) and 2D/3D ADR-007 camera decision settled and verified in Editor (open residual)
- [ ] \[CMD-28\] Game options / map settings (CMO §6.4-5, line 36) expose persistent UI-local map preferences cleanly alongside the menu/layer stack.

### CMD-30 — Tactical overlay control (CMD-30.1..11) (lines 263-312)

Projection-backed tactical overlays (CMD-30.1..11): 8-way range symbology, belief styling, merged hulls, text beside swatches, engagement vectors, comms/EMCON overlays, routes, datablocks, camera follow/LOS/minimaps, legends, group/unit toggle, palette audit, and custom overlays (20:38). Partial projections exist; full taxonomy, hulls, datablocks, LOS, legends, and audit remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-30\] Tactical overlays consume headless projections (ADR-010) and include explicit '(Current: ON/OFF)' text alongside color swatches (CMD-30.4)
- [ ] \[CMD-30\] 8-way range taxonomy, non-friendly belief styling, merged hulls, datablocks, legends, and palette accessibility audit completed (open residual)
- [ ] \[CMD-30\] Custom overlays (CMO §10.2, line 38) integrate cleanly with the projection-backed tactical overlay surface when enabled.

### SWARM-14 — C2 unit panel swarm fields (mode, integrity, host, links, sensors/weapons) (Phase B, P1) (lines 169-174)

Partial+ (SwarmUnitPanelProjection.ProjectPhaseB / SwarmPanelSnapshot expose mode, integrity, host, linkState, cecMeshState); lacks primary sensor/weapon summary, composite-track contribution, energy/endurance, Unity UI panel chrome, and map-app6-frame--friendly-swarm USS/atlas rendering.

- [ ] \[SWARM-14\] Selected swarm unit panel (headless + Unity UI) shows mode, integrity, energy/endurance if modelled, host, linkState, cecMeshState/composite-track contribution, and primary sensor/weapon summary, updating live with CMD-17 unknown reasons.

### SWARM-16 — Swarm formations: cloud, wall/screen, spear, orbit (Phase C, P2) (lines 240-243)

Formations (cloud, wall/screen, spear, orbit) act as soft constraints on member layout and engagement geometry. SwarmController.IssueSetFormation stores unit.Formation and SwarmFormationLayout exists standalone (swarm-c1 PASS), but SwarmFormationLayout and GetFormation have 0 production callers in engagement geometry or unity/.

- [ ] \[SWARM-16\] Wire SwarmFormationLayout / GetFormation into production engagement geometry and/or Unity member layout rendering so formation orders constrain layout and geometry deterministically.

### SWARM-17 — Multi-axis auto-split assault (Phase C, P2) (lines 244-247)

Assault may split logical mass across approach axes against a single high-value target when doctrine allows. SwarmAssaultAxisSplitter exists standalone (swarm-c2 PASS), but has 0 production callers in src/ or unity/ and EffectivePolicy/data policies lack a split-doctrine field (AllowSplit).

- [ ] \[SWARM-17\] Add split-doctrine field to EffectivePolicy / scenario policy JSON and wire SwarmAssaultAxisSplitter into production SwarmController / engagement assault resolution.

before_state.title: Support formation and task-group combat coordination
before_state.description:
Source: `Game-Requirements/drafts/25-C2-Nodes-Mission-Command.md` (lines 107-128)
Req IDs: C2N-03
Lifecycle: Draft — owner acceptance pending
Notion: [https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df819aa570e87f9f101aec](<https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df819aa570e87f9f101aec>)
Acceptance Criteria:

- [ ] Draft (pending owner): Gap precedence resolves strictly Split > NoC2 > Unassigned > None (COORD OK)

---

## Goal

Make escorting, sectors, shared targeting, and group-level combat intent visible and controllable.

## Acceptance criteria

* Shows responsibility boundaries and group-to-unit command effects.
* Explains when coordination or delegation prevents an action.
* Preserves the established command and projection boundaries.

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** parent epic [DRG-185](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-185>); related layered defense [DRG-192](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-192>), authority [DRG-182](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-182>)/[DRG-209](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-209>).
* **Decision needed (CMANO):** AC is not testable as written; which coordination types (escort, sector, shared targeting) are in the first cut and what 'controllable' means are product scope choices.

Acceptance Criteria:

### KCX-01 (Draft — owner acceptance pending)

- [ ] Draft (pending owner): Given an identified target with active fire-control tracking and an in-DLZ shooter with ammo, SensorToShooterProjection evaluates IsComplete=true, PrimaryBreakCause=None, and all 4 links IsLinked=true.

- [ ] Draft (pending owner): TargetabilityAcceptProjection evaluates acceptability across authority, provenance, and sensor-to-shooter chains emitting explicit cause codes (MissingProvenance, CatalogMiss, Stale, SilentComms, ApprovalRequired).

---

Verify common-picture, allocation, and resilience behavior through deterministic mission threads.

* Covers normal, degraded-link, lost-node, conflicting-allocation, and authority-withheld cases.

* Uses the kill-chain traceability matrix as the coverage gate.

## Deliverable

Reproducible C2 workflow evidence and bounded defect follow-up under the existing A-C implementation owners, following G2 in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-08-slice-g-unity-ux-ui.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

* Validate map/OOB/detail/review selection, history-to-live transitions, command availability and refusal, approval-required state and alert interruption/recovery.
* Exercise empty, stale, unknown and comms-loss states using grounded inputs.
* Controls remain reachable at baseline 1600x979 and 1280x779 and supported UI scale extremes; include keyboard and pointer checks distinct from callback automation.
* Reuse <issue id="7565c7a4-b3ff-4d35-aaea-4ff7f56452bd" label="DRG-170" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-170/validate-combat-declutter-accessibility-and-replay" />/177/205 for accessibility, declutter, replay and usability evidence.
* Preserve <issue id="0381b880-6dcf-4bbf-8a9d-2207f67d280a" label="DRG-185" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-185/epic-slice-c-command-learn-adapt" />/175/192 ownership of positive group/BDA and live coverage gaps. Fixtures are explicitly labeled and cannot be reported as live-scenario proof.
* Each failure links to a requirement and existing owner or a newly justified defect.

## Dependencies and boundaries

G1 baseline first. GitNexus <issue id="72627172-94af-41de-b160-61e0febb7890" label="DRG-197" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-197/reindex-gitnexus-and-verify-the-post-implementation-knowledge-graph" /> recovery before any symbol edits. Reuse current projection/command boundaries; DelegationBridge remains untouched. Owner acceptance is separate from technical smoke.

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

Use the delivery plan's integrated degraded-comms acceptance scenario for the first package: plan/assign → accelerate/alert → inspect doctrine/refusal → intervene/return → lose link → recover → replay.

Record commit, scenario/catalog/policy, seed, input steps, expected/actual behavior, screenshots and linked failures. Prove actual live-source composition before calling a result live; otherwise label it as a fixture. <issue id="bbd11124-fd93-497b-8619-9c8fb864d9e6" label="DRG-414" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-414/expose-production-fire-controlshooterauthority-facts-so-the-slice-a" />/417 remain dependencies for their specific production-fed claims.

Preserve current ownership of group/BDA and coverage gaps. Test keyboard and pointer flows separately from callback automation. Distinguish headless, proxy, Editor and owner evidence. <issue id="066c5b74-3cec-4f52-9eba-4ef15653abab" label="DRG-208" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208/play-human-play-mode-re-signoff-at-9cd872c7" />'s Done state for an older revision does not accept this new package.

No Editor execution or owner acceptance occurred; status remains Backlog.

Architect ACCEPT. REQ-04 Override & Intervention.

**User story:** As a player, I want to seize, pause, and return a delegated unit from the unit panel.

## AC

- [ ] Take control yields agent immediately; unit shows Human; group member detaches per locked decision
- [ ] Pause suspends intents without clearing tasking; Resume restores
- [ ] Return to agent rejoins/resumes; order-log ControllerChange

First-package control-handoff lane. Reuse delivered controller badges/initial assignment; do not rebuild them.

* Exactly one active controller after take/return; rejected or repeated commands cannot duplicate orders or log events.
* Distinguish agent pause from simulation pause and from taking direct control.

* Verify group detach/rejoin, retained tasking and pending-human-order behavior.

* Register all supported handoff commands with the <issue id="d224a671-afb7-4ea8-bf7e-84279249c710" label="DRG-348" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348/h6-save-contract-define-complete-same-buildcatalog-save-resume-state" /> input-journal inventory.

These are not a Surface stamp. Runtime remains Backlog; GitNexus unavailable while the development laptop is offline.

before_state.title: EPIC [H4] Scenario Editor Phase 2 GUI — scope intake
before_state.description:
Source: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-08-scenario-editor-phase2-design.md`; `Game-Requirements/requirements/11-Agentic-Mission-Editor.md` (line 94)
Req IDs: AME-1.2
Lifecycle: Active (H4 scope intake; blocked on owner GO)
Notion: [https://www.notion.so/3e8f7cb4e4df814893b6c9208b94a659](<https://www.notion.so/3e8f7cb4e4df814893b6c9208b94a659>)

## Context

The headless Scenario Editor is complete: S81–S88, the SE completion program (SE-W0–W3), the P2.1 headless slice (`production/scenario-editor-phase2-1-scope-boundary-2026-07-08.md`), and ME Phase 2 completion (`production/epics/mission-editor-phase2-completion/EPIC.md`). H4 is about the **GUI** on top of that core.

**Already on** `main`**:**

* Data core: `src/ProjectAegis.Data/Scenario/Authoring/` (`ScenarioAuthoringSession`, `ScenarioEditCommandBus`, `ScenarioDocumentEditor`, `ScenarioUndoStackStore`, `MissionBoardQuery`, `EventStaticAnalyzer`)
* Headless presenters: `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Authoring/` (`EditModeController`, `MapAuthoringSurface`, `LiveFindingsPresenter`, `MissionBoardPresenter`, `EventGraphPresenter`, `SelectionInspectorModel`)
* Unity hosts: `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/ScenarioMapAuthoringWindow.cs`, `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/ScenarioEditorShellHost.cs`, `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/UI/ScenarioEditor/*`

**Approved design:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-08-scenario-editor-phase2-design.md`, with slices P2.1 map/ORBAT/zones, P2.2 Mission Board, and P2.3 event graph. UX: `design/ux/scenario-editor.md`.

**Open gaps:**

* Editor-host manual smoke steps 2–6 are still open in `production/qa/scenario-editor-p2-1-editor-host-checklist.md`.
* 21 Phase 2 GUI UX findings are parked in the Notion ME UX review. The trigger issue [DRG-57] was canceled 2026-07-26 with its five scope questions unanswered.
* ADR-017 (editor topology) is still **Proposed**, with a target decision date of 2026-10-01.
* The `cmano-clone` H4 milestone text also bundles a "WYSIWYG platform editor". That needs an in/out decision.

## Entry gate

Product prioritization + a **new scope boundary doc** (roadmap §14).

## Related (coordinate, do not duplicate)

* [DRG-57]: canceled H4 trigger. It carries the five questions and the UX wave sizing.
* [DRG-236] / [DRG-274]: Slice G3 editor workflow evidence (Backlog). If G3 runs first, it supplies H4's evidence baseline.

## Hard-no exposure (ADR required before touching)

* `CatalogWriteGate` writes, if the WYSIWYG platform editor is folded in. ADR-011 keeps Excel as the primary authoring path.
* `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` / `GlobeMapProductHost`: Approach A extends the C2 map into Edit Mode, but P2.1 Task 0 says not to overload runtime C2 hosts.
* `SimulationSession` / `DelegationBridge`: the play-from-editor and sample path must keep using existing APIs.
* S122: must not ride the S122 train.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Owner prioritization recorded: open H4, defer it, or run a corrective slice against M6
- [ ] Scope boundary doc merged under `production/` (In/Out, first vertical slice, invariants, Surfaces)
- [ ] WYSIWYG platform editor decided in or out of H4
- [ ] Child implementation stories exist with resolved dispatch Surfaces (disjoint from hard-no list) before sprint kickoff

Target scope: docs-only scope intake (dispatch surfaces assigned at sprint kickoff)

## Start condition

**Nothing is started until the owner gives GO for H4.** This issue stays in Backlog: do not set it In Progress and do not dispatch agents.

Invariants unchanged: floor per `production/test-floor.json` (≥1638, 0 failed) · ReplayGolden 6/6 · hash `17144800277401907079` · PlayModeSmoke ≥20/20 · DelegationBridge ZERO hotpath · CatalogWriteGate extend-only · Stage Release.

Acceptance Criteria:

- [ ] Every denied fire intent produces a PolicyDenial order-log entry with FireAbortReason and

---

## Context

Deferred from Codex P1 on [PR #683](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/683#discussion_r4162411970>) (<issue id="5ac73570-f572-45f1-bc7b-013650ad64ed" label="DRG-258" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-258/c2-01-weapon-abort-tooltip-top-3-fireabortreason" /> weapon abort tooltip).

## Suggestion

Codex claims `VisualElement.tooltip` is Editor-only and that denied weapon rows never show abort reasons at runtime without a `TooltipEvent` handler or custom popup.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for <pull-request id="02016151-53ae-41dd-80ad-670161762666" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#683" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featui-drg-258-weapon-abort-tooltip-04b102b898f5" /> land)

The same host already assigns `button.tooltip` for <issue id="edefdae9-4a5b-49dc-ba94-cc0d4a461203" label="DRG-262" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-262/c2-05-attack-options-menu-preview-parity" /> attack-menu options; <issue id="5ac73570-f572-45f1-bc7b-013650ad64ed" label="DRG-258" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-258/c2-01-weapon-abort-tooltip-top-3-fireabortreason" /> reuses that UITK path on focusable weapon rows. Owner LGTM accepted the binder + row chrome. Play Mode visibility is the existing human gate <issue id="066c5b74-3cec-4f52-9eba-4ef15653abab" label="DRG-208" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208/play-human-play-mode-re-signoff-at-1902dc12" />, not a Surface-widening popup rewrite in this land wave.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* In Play Mode, confirm hover/focus on a denied fire row shows the abort tooltip text.
* If UITK default tooltips do not appear under the game PanelSettings, add a small runtime tooltip presenter (TooltipEvent / popup) shared with attack-button tooltips — keep ADR-010 presentation-only.

before_state.description:
Source: `Game-Requirements/requirements/17-Replay-AAR-And-Order-Log.md` (106; +3 below)
Req IDs: RPL-15, OPS-01, PRD-P1-2, UI-08
Lifecycle: Active; Draft (pending owner)

Acceptance Criteria:

- [ ] MessageCategoryPolicy maps categories to Log/Pause/Balloon/1x via facade.

---

Wiki: [https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc>)

Additional Sources:

* Source: `notion://3f2f7cb4e4df8199aad8f1dd50c6831e` (Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07, 66)
* Source: `docs/product/prd-mvp-ui-2026-07-15.md` (96)
* Source: `docs/product/ui-requirements-brainstorm-2026-07-15.md` (47-55)

## Problem

The message log has no per-category notification policy. In CMO, each message type (new contact, weapon launch, weapon endgame, unit lost, fuel, etc.) can be set to: show in the log, raise a pop-up that pauses the sim, show a balloon on the map at the subject, and drop time compression to 1x. Without this, a player running at high time compression can miss a hostile launch or a lost unit until well after it happens. Aegis has pause and acceleration (<issue id="33bfdfcc-aeed-49b3-b9a5-e2dd6df86193" label="DRG-14" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause" />) and a message log (<issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" />), but nothing links log categories to attention or time-control behavior.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual, Game Options → Message Log: per message type, "Show on Message Log", "Raise Pop-Up" (pauses the game), "Show Balloon" (on the map at the subject's location), and "Timescale X1" (drop from acceleration to 1x). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/>)
* CMO manual §3.1.7: the log is split into categories that can be minimized or emphasized, so routine messages don't bury critical ones. Hovering a message highlights its subject on the map. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* Player feedback asks for exactly this per-type control, including keeping time running while still being notified. [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/](<https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" /> covers click → unit deep-link, and <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> covers sourcing combat lines from CombatEvent. Neither covers category policy or time-control escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageCategoryPolicy` projection maps each message category to {Log, Pause, Balloon, DropToRealTime}. Defaults are data-driven, not hardcoded.
* When a matching message arrives, the projection emits an attention intent. Pause and 1x requests go through the existing command/time façade as player-visible requests. The projection never calls sim internals directly, and the change does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath or SimulationSession.
* The UI binds only to the projection. A settings panel edits the policy, and balloon markers anchor to the message subject.
* Replay is deterministic: under AttachReplayViewer, policy-driven pauses are suppressed or reported but never change the order log.
* Tests cover the default mapping, a user override, and the no-op under replay.

Additional AC:

* Source alerts from the permitted live view; hidden information must not leak through sound, balloon, count or pause.
* Process each event identity once across refresh/reopen; replay scrubbing produces no live command.
* Deterministic simultaneous-intent precedence, with Pause above DropTo1x; dismissing one alert does not clear another unresolved pause reason.
* Routine coalescing retains counts and never suppresses a newly actionable approval.
* Verify safe-stop timing against actual accelerated pipeline steps; next-frame visual notification alone is insufficient.
* Reuse MessageLogBridge.ProjectLive and inspect C2ClockCommand; keep policy projection free of simulation mutation.

before_state.title: Exit MissionEditor.Cli→Ai.Host in-process reference
before_state.description:
Source: `docs/architecture/waivers/waiver-mission-editor-cli-ai-host-2026-11-16.md`
Waiver scope: `docs/architecture/waivers/waiver-mission-editor-cli-ai-host-2026-11-16.md` (waiver PR); implementation scope deferred to process-split work on `src/ProjectAegis.MissionEditor.Cli/**` ; `src/ProjectAegis.Ai.Host/**` ; matching `*Tests`

Draft waiver PR: #873

## Problem

PR #860 added a `ProjectReference` from `ProjectAegis.MissionEditor.Cli` to `ProjectAegis.Ai.Host`. That in-process edge pulls `Microsoft.Extensions.AI` into the authoring CLI and conflicts with ADR-030's preferred boundary (rejected alternative: "An AI folder inside the Mission Editor CLI"; preferred: thin CLI verbs calling a separate `Ai.Host`).

Recorded as [DRG-771](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-771/architecture-compliance-audit-last-10-sprints-cmano-clone>) §8 item 1. Owner go (7:40 PM CT Nov 16, phrase **Accept jev's calls**) chose **waive with an exit ticket** rather than amending ADR-030 or forcing an immediate process split.

## Waiver (docs only — this ticket is the exit)

Temporary waiver lives at:

`docs/architecture/waivers/waiver-mission-editor-cli-ai-host-2026-11-16.md`

ADR-030 status stays **Accepted**; this waiver does not amend the ADR.

## Required fix (implementation)

Replace the in-process `ProjectReference` with a **thin CLI verb that calls a separate** `Ai.Host` **process** (IPC / process boundary). Do this **before** any live-provider or credential wiring.

Out of scope for this ticket until the process split lands:

* Removing the csproj reference without the process boundary ready
* Live provider adapters
* Credential / secret wiring
* Paid-provider CI paths

## Related — stay open

* [DRG-728](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-728>) (**AI-DEC-2** provider / terms / cost ceiling) remains **open** and must stay open. Do not close it from this work.
* Parent audit: [DRG-771](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-771>)

## Scope (when implementing)

```
Target files (pending sprint dispatch): src/ProjectAegis.MissionEditor.Cli/** ; src/ProjectAegis.Ai.Host/** ; matching *Tests ; no CatalogWriteGate / DelegationBridge / SimulationSession
```

## Done when

1. MissionEditor.Cli no longer ProjectReferences `Ai.Host`.
2. CLI AI verbs invoke a separate `Ai.Host` process (documented contract).
3. Architecture / boundary gates still green; no AI packages on Unity-bound projects.
4. Waiver marked exited with PR link.

## Problem

PR <pull-request id="1e443860-106b-409d-ab13-ec351a172305" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#669" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featui-drg-264-contact-list-sortfilter-fog-mode-briefing-label-303bcb7f65f7" /> added `using ProjectAegis.Sim.Scenario` to Unity `C2TopBarPanelHost.cs` and reads `Orchestrator.ScenarioPolicy.PlayerInfoModel` directly (`ResolvePlayerInfoModel`, \~lines 515–518) for fog-mode chrome. That bypasses [ADR-010](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/main/docs/architecture/adr-010-headless-first-command-driven-ui.md>) §3 (presentation consumes read-only projections).

`docs/architecture/waivers/waiver-c2-topbar-sim-read-2026-11-16.md`

ADR-010 status stays **Accepted**; this waiver does not amend the ADR.

1. Expose `PlayerInfoModel` (or equivalent fog/info-model field) on a headless projection the top bar already binds (prefer extending an existing top-bar / loop-policy projection).
2. Update `C2TopBarPanelHost` to consume that projection only; remove `using ProjectAegis.Sim.Scenario` and direct `ScenarioPolicy` / `PlayerInfoModel` type use from the host.
3. Keep the path **read-only** (ADR-010 §2–3). No writes into Sim/Delegation; no `DelegationBridge` hotpath, `SimulationSession`, `CatalogWriteGate`, or `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` edits under this ticket unless separately reserved.

## Out of scope until projection lands

* Expanding other Unity → Sim imports (including `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` baseline)
* Amending ADR-010 text/status
* Live Editor-only chrome polish without a projection contract

## Related

* Parent audit: [DRG-771](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-771>)
* Disjoint from [DRG-772](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-772>) (MissionEditor.Cli → [Ai.Host](<http://Ai.Host>) / ADR-030)

## Target Files (pending sprint dispatch)

`unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/C2TopBarPanelHost.cs ; matching projection / binder / *Tests under UnityAdapter or Presentation ; no DelegationBridge / SimulationSession / CatalogWriteGate / MapPlaceholderPanelHost`

## Done when

1. Top bar fog/info-model chrome binds a projection, not `Orchestrator.ScenarioPolicy` from Unity.
2. `C2TopBarPanelHost.cs` has no `ProjectAegis.Sim.Scenario` import.
3. Waiver marked exited with implementing PR link.
4. Headless gates green; Unity MCP noted if Editor/visual proof is required.

### HOL-02 — Pending Approval Queue & Execution Gate (lines 92-97)

Maintain session-local PendingApprovalQueue for orders flagged GateResult.QueueForApproval (plus EscalationGateProjection), enforcing explicit human approval before execution. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-02\] Orders enqueued to PendingApprovalQueue MUST NOT execute until explicitly approved via TryApprove(orderId).
- [ ] \[HOL-02\] Rejection via TryReject(orderId) MUST remove the entry without execution.
- [ ] \[HOL-02\] Approved orders drain via DrainApproved() and promote to ExecutedOrders on the subsequent simulation tick.
- [ ] \[HOL-02\] Queue operations MUST be idempotent; duplicate OrderId submissions MUST be ignored.

### HOL-03 — C2 Authority & Targeting Disposition Projection (lines 99-104)

Project ROE, track source, fire-control status, and required approval into explicit dispositions (Permitted, Withheld, ApprovalRequired) across the six core action verbs via C2AuthorityProjector. Draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-03\] When RoeLevel is HoldFire or WeaponsTight, targeting disposition MUST be Withheld (RoeHoldFire or WeaponsTight).
- [ ] \[HOL-03\] When track source is DatalinkShared or FusedWithoutOrganicFc, targeting disposition MUST be Withheld (SHARED_TRACK_NO_RELEASE, ADR-018).
- [ ] \[HOL-03\] When RequiredApproval is Operator or WeaponsRelease, disposition MUST be ApprovalRequired with corresponding reason codes.
- [ ] \[HOL-03\] All six core verbs (Observe, Recommend, Approve, Engage, Abort, Retask) MUST receive an explicit C2AuthorityActionState.

### HOL-05 — Agent C2 Skill Contract & Envelopes (lines 112-116)

Enforce structured skill envelope validation (SkillEnvelopeValidator, SkillCatalog, SkillIds) across segregated Read, Propose, and Submit lanes against known C2CommandIssuance verbs. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-05\] Every envelope MUST declare lane (Read, Propose, or Submit), skillId, invocationId, and time credentials (simTick, simTime).
- [ ] \[HOL-05\] Propose and submit envelopes MUST include authorityBasis, requiredApproval, playerOverride, and evidence pointers.
- [ ] \[HOL-05\] SkillEnvelopeValidator MUST validate command IDs against known C2CommandIssuance verbs and reject malformed envelopes.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### HOL-06 — Advisory Threat Assessment & Weapon Recommendation (HOL Boundary) (lines 118-123)

Ensure headless ThreatAssessmentProjection evaluates DLZ range, magazine state, mount status, and doctrine purely as an advisory recommendation without issuing fire orders. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-06\] WeaponRecommendation MUST explicitly assert IsWeaponsReleaseAuthorization=false, IsFireOrder=false, and IsAutomaticEngagement=false.
- [ ] \[HOL-06\] Outcomes MUST classify into Feasible, WithheldByPolicy, or WithheldByEngage.
- [ ] \[HOL-06\] Recommendations MUST include human-readable assumptions, DLZ range assessment, policy constraints, confidence score, and status line.
- [ ] \[HOL-06\] ComputeFingerprint MUST produce deterministic, replay-stable fingerprints across runs given identical inputs.

### HOL-07 — Resource Scarcity Ranking & Weapon Pairing (lines 125-130)

Evaluate and rank candidate shooter/weapon pairings under scarcity constraints via ResourceRankProjection using five deterministic weights without authorizing weapons release. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-07\] ResourceRankSnapshot MUST assert IsWeaponsReleaseAuthorization=false, IsFireOrder=false, and IsAutomaticEngagement=false.
- [ ] \[HOL-07\] Candidates MUST be scored using weights: Expected Effect (0.35), Time-to-Effect (0.20), Round Availability (0.20), Commitment (0.15), Magazine Conservation (0.10).
- [ ] \[HOL-07\] Candidates MUST categorize into Preferred (rank 1), Alternative (rank 2+), or Excluded with explicit reason codes.
- [ ] \[HOL-07\] ComputeFingerprint MUST produce a deterministic fingerprint string.

### HOL-08 — Collateral Damage Estimation (CDE) & Advisory Withhold (lines 132-136)

Project advisory collateral risk levels (Low, Elevated, Withheld), range classes, and policy denials via CdeAssessProjection without issuing fire authorizations. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-08\] CdeAssessSnapshot MUST be strictly advisory and MUST NOT emit weapons release or fire authorizations.
- [ ] \[HOL-08\] Risk MUST categorize as Low, Elevated, or Withheld (explicit collateral withhold or shooter-scoped policy denials).
- [ ] \[HOL-08\] Projections MUST record explicit assumptions regarding engage preview, policy denial records, and CDE withhold status.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### HOL-06 — Advisory Threat Assessment & Weapon Recommendation (HOL Boundary) (lines 118-123)

Ensure headless ThreatAssessmentProjection evaluates DLZ range, magazine state, mount status, and doctrine purely as an advisory recommendation without issuing fire orders. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-06\] WeaponRecommendation MUST explicitly assert IsWeaponsReleaseAuthorization=false, IsFireOrder=false, and IsAutomaticEngagement=false.
- [ ] \[HOL-06\] Outcomes MUST classify into Feasible, WithheldByPolicy, or WithheldByEngage.
- [ ] \[HOL-06\] Recommendations MUST include human-readable assumptions, DLZ range assessment, policy constraints, confidence score, and status line.
- [ ] \[HOL-06\] ComputeFingerprint MUST produce deterministic, replay-stable fingerprints across runs given identical inputs.

### HOL-07 — Resource Scarcity Ranking & Weapon Pairing (lines 125-130)

Evaluate and rank candidate shooter/weapon pairings under scarcity constraints via ResourceRankProjection using five deterministic weights without authorizing weapons release. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-07\] ResourceRankSnapshot MUST assert IsWeaponsReleaseAuthorization=false, IsFireOrder=false, and IsAutomaticEngagement=false.
- [ ] \[HOL-07\] Candidates MUST be scored using weights: Expected Effect (0.35), Time-to-Effect (0.20), Round Availability (0.20), Commitment (0.15), Magazine Conservation (0.10).
- [ ] \[HOL-07\] Candidates MUST categorize into Preferred (rank 1), Alternative (rank 2+), or Excluded with explicit reason codes.
- [ ] \[HOL-07\] ComputeFingerprint MUST produce a deterministic fingerprint string.

### HOL-08 — Collateral Damage Estimation (CDE) & Advisory Withhold (lines 132-136)

Project advisory collateral risk levels (Low, Elevated, Withheld), range classes, and policy denials via CdeAssessProjection without issuing fire authorizations. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-08\] CdeAssessSnapshot MUST be strictly advisory and MUST NOT emit weapons release or fire authorizations.
- [ ] \[HOL-08\] Risk MUST categorize as Low, Elevated, or Withheld (explicit collateral withhold or shooter-scoped policy denials).
- [ ] \[HOL-08\] Projections MUST record explicit assumptions regarding engage preview, policy denial records, and CDE withhold status.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### AGD-04 — Four Autonomy Levels with ROE/Policy Gate and Lethal Opt-In (lines 32-39)

Implement four autonomy levels (Manual, Assisted, SemiAutonomous, FullAutonomous) integrated with ROE/policy evaluation (AutonomyGate + RoePolicyAdapter), requiring explicit player opt-in per mission phase for full-autonomous lethal engagement.

- [ ] \[AGD-04\] AutonomyLevel defines Manual, Assisted, SemiAutonomous, and FullAutonomous tiers gated by AutonomyGate and IRoeFilter.
- [ ] \[AGD-04\] Full autonomous lethal engagement enforces explicit player opt-in per mission phase (aligned with PendingApprovalQueue / HOL).

### AGD-07 — Realistic Variability via Deterministic Trait-Weighted Softmax DecisionPipeline (lines 60-63)

Exhibit human-like decision variability (mistakes, hesitation, personality styles). DecisionPipeline softmax (Decisiveness), SeededRng, SlowerReactions (ReactionDelay\*5), and NarrowedFocus (Take(2)) are shipped, while ErrorRate, Aggression, and RiskTolerance candidate scoring remain unwired across DecisionPipeline and IPolicy implementations.

- [ ] \[AGD-07\] DecisionPipeline selects among candidate actions deterministically using SeededRng given identical seed, traits, candidates, and attention state.
- [ ] \[AGD-07\] ErrorRate (occasional mistakes), Aggression, and RiskTolerance drive candidate scoring and personality-specific decision styles in IPolicy/DecisionPipeline rather than remaining unwired.

### AGD-09 — Agent Delegation Responsiveness, Logging, and ROE Compliance NFRs (lines 69-75)

Ensure delegation remains responsive at thousands of entities without performance degradation, logs 100% of agent decisions for replay, and strictly respects ROE and player-defined constraints.

- [ ] \[AGD-09\] All agent intents pass through AutonomyGate and IRoeFilter before execution.
- [ ] \[AGD-09\] Delegation tick overhead remains bounded as entity count scales.

### AGD-11 — Agent Attention and Bandwidth Model with Graceful Degradation (lines 136-144)

Enforce per-agent attention budget (default 20, personality-modulated) scaling load by contacts/engagements/groups and degrading overloaded decisions. AttentionCalculator, SlowerReactions, and NarrowedFocus + IsOverloaded temperature scaling are shipped, while SimplerDecisions (>1.5x budget) is UI-only and overload integration tests are missing.

- [ ] \[AGD-11\] AttentionCalculator computes load from contacts, engagements, and group members against personality-modulated budget (default 20), with SlowerReactions and NarrowedFocus active.
- [ ] \[AGD-11\] SimplerDecisions drives simpler decision behavior in AgentController/DecisionPipeline (beyond UI projection) and overload degradation is covered by integration tests beyond AttentionCalculator.Evaluate.

### AGD-14 — Delegation Comms Degradation and Attention Coupling (lines 106-106)

Integrate CommsTimelineSimulator order delays and stale/datalink flags into agent observations and reduce effective attention budget under degraded comms (Phase 2), with EW Specialist preset balancing comms/EMCON tradeoffs.

- [ ] \[AGD-14\] Agents observe stale/datalink status flags from comms timelines without breaking determinism.
- [ ] \[AGD-14\] Degraded comms modulates effective attention budget per doc 19 integration.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### AGD-04 — Four Autonomy Levels with ROE/Policy Gate and Lethal Opt-In (lines 32-39)

Implement four autonomy levels (Manual, Assisted, SemiAutonomous, FullAutonomous) integrated with ROE/policy evaluation (AutonomyGate + RoePolicyAdapter), requiring explicit player opt-in per mission phase for full-autonomous lethal engagement.

- [ ] \[AGD-04\] AutonomyLevel defines Manual, Assisted, SemiAutonomous, and FullAutonomous tiers gated by AutonomyGate and IRoeFilter.
- [ ] \[AGD-04\] Full autonomous lethal engagement enforces explicit player opt-in per mission phase (aligned with PendingApprovalQueue / HOL).

### AGD-07 — Realistic Variability via Deterministic Trait-Weighted Softmax DecisionPipeline (lines 60-63)

Exhibit human-like decision variability (mistakes, hesitation, personality styles). DecisionPipeline softmax (Decisiveness), SeededRng, SlowerReactions (ReactionDelay\*5), and NarrowedFocus (Take(2)) are shipped, while ErrorRate, Aggression, and RiskTolerance candidate scoring remain unwired across DecisionPipeline and IPolicy implementations.

- [ ] \[AGD-07\] DecisionPipeline selects among candidate actions deterministically using SeededRng given identical seed, traits, candidates, and attention state.
- [ ] \[AGD-07\] ErrorRate (occasional mistakes), Aggression, and RiskTolerance drive candidate scoring and personality-specific decision styles in IPolicy/DecisionPipeline rather than remaining unwired.

### AGD-09 — Agent Delegation Responsiveness, Logging, and ROE Compliance NFRs (lines 69-75)

Ensure delegation remains responsive at thousands of entities without performance degradation, logs 100% of agent decisions for replay, and strictly respects ROE and player-defined constraints.

- [ ] \[AGD-09\] All agent intents pass through AutonomyGate and IRoeFilter before execution.
- [ ] \[AGD-09\] Delegation tick overhead remains bounded as entity count scales.

### AGD-11 — Agent Attention and Bandwidth Model with Graceful Degradation (lines 136-144)

Enforce per-agent attention budget (default 20, personality-modulated) scaling load by contacts/engagements/groups and degrading overloaded decisions. AttentionCalculator, SlowerReactions, and NarrowedFocus + IsOverloaded temperature scaling are shipped, while SimplerDecisions (>1.5x budget) is UI-only and overload integration tests are missing.

- [ ] \[AGD-11\] AttentionCalculator computes load from contacts, engagements, and group members against personality-modulated budget (default 20), with SlowerReactions and NarrowedFocus active.
- [ ] \[AGD-11\] SimplerDecisions drives simpler decision behavior in AgentController/DecisionPipeline (beyond UI projection) and overload degradation is covered by integration tests beyond AttentionCalculator.Evaluate.

### AGD-14 — Delegation Comms Degradation and Attention Coupling (lines 106-106)

Integrate CommsTimelineSimulator order delays and stale/datalink flags into agent observations and reduce effective attention budget under degraded comms (Phase 2), with EW Specialist preset balancing comms/EMCON tradeoffs.

- [ ] \[AGD-14\] Agents observe stale/datalink status flags from comms timelines without breaking determinism.
- [ ] \[AGD-14\] Degraded comms modulates effective attention budget per doc 19 integration.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### ROE-01 — Policy inheritance chain with provenance and cascade/lock controls (lines 31-46)

Resolve effective policy by specificity (unit, embarked, mission, group, side, scenario), expose it in UI/MCP, track override provenance, and cascade/lock parent edits. Headless unit->mission->side resolution and validation exist, while group/embarked inheritance, full provenance persistence, and cascade UI remain open.

- [ ] \[ROE-01\] Side ROE weapons tight with mission override weapons free resolves accurately per mission and unit, and embarked units inherit from their host or mission.
- [ ] \[ROE-01\] Effective policy inspection exposes resolved values and provenance (inherited, user, agent, event, scenario_template) across UI and tooling.
- [ ] \[ROE-01\] Parent policy edits support designer choice to cascade to or lock child overrides.

### ROE-04 — WRA per weapon/mount class (salvo, range bands, target categories) (lines 80-84)

Enforce Weapon Release Authority (WRA) per weapon type or mount class for max salvo, range bands, and target categories prior to engagement resolution, aborting with FireAbortReason.WRA\_\*. MaxSalvo enforcement and UI binder exist, while per-weapon/mount/range/target-category WRA tables remain unmodeled.

- [ ] \[ROE-04\] WRA max salvo limits block excess rounds (e.g., max salvo 2 blocks a 3-round salvo) with FireAbortReason.WraSalvo and display remaining salvo allowance in UI.
- [ ] \[ROE-04\] WRA range-band and target-category rules evaluate per weapon/mount class prior to engagement resolution and return FireAbortReason.WraRange or category denial codes.

### ROE-05 — EMCON per emitter class and mission EMCON schedules (lines 85-90)

Model per-emitter EMCON states (off, passive, active) across radar, sonar, ESM, datalink, and OECM affecting detection and enemy ESM, plus P1 mission-level EMCON schedules. Radar EMCON gating and HUD projection exist, while multi-emitter class inheritance and scheduled transitions remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[ROE-05\] EMCON passive or off on an emitter class prevents active emissions (such as active radar illumination) while allowing passive ESM reception and citing EMCON on fire abort.
- [ ] \[ROE-05\] Per-emitter EMCON controls cover radar, sonar, ESM, datalink, and OECM, and mission schedules transition EMCON deterministically at mission waypoints/phases.

### ROE-06 — Doctrine behavioral rules, withdraw/redeploy, posture, and special actions (lines 91-95)

Support mission doctrine (ignore course, opportunity targets, refuel/UNREP, withdraw on damage/ammo/bingo, nuclear gating) plus side posture and special-action gates. Damage-withdraw gates and assisted confirm UI exist, while full behavioral doctrine, fuel/ammo withdraw destinations, posture transitions, and nuclear/special gates remain open.

- [ ] \[ROE-06\] Exceeding configured damage, magazine, or bingo-fuel withdraw thresholds triggers a deterministic withdraw/redeploy decision or Assisted player confirmation prompt.
- [ ] \[ROE-06\] Ignore plotted course, engage opportunity targets, refuel/UNREP doctrine, hostile/neutral/friendly posture, and scenario-gated nuclear/special actions are enforced deterministically.

### ENG-05 — DLZ state evaluation, live HUD indicator, and DLZ_CLOSING abort handling (lines 66-72)

Pre-compute DLZ states (inZone, approaching, outOfZone, unknown), surface DLZ cues on contact hover and weapon panels, and abort with DLZ_OUT or DLZ_CLOSING. - [ ] \[ENG-TARGET-01\] Engagement resolver rejects invalid or non-existent contact IDs before magazine consumption and honors doc 18 BDA/re-attack rules.
- [ ] \[ENG-TARGET-01\] Identification threshold (hostile assumed vs confirmed) is enforced deterministically by active ROE before weapon launch.

Enforce targeting prerequisites: engage only valid contact IDs, apply doc 18 BDA/re-attack rules, and enforce ROE identification thresholds (hostile assumed vs confirmed). - [ ] \[ENG-TARGET-01\] Identification threshold (hostile assumed vs confirmed) is enforced deterministically by active ROE before weapon launch.

Extend contact records with multi-sensor provenance (sourceSensorIds\[\] listing all contributing sensors) and position uncertainty (ellipse/covariance, simplified to radius for MVP UI) plus contactId, observer sideId, lastUpdatedSimTick, and stale flag. - [ ] \[SEN-TRACK-FIELDS\] Each contact exposes sourceSensorIds\[\] enumerating all contributing sensors for multi-sensor provenance explainability.

### SEN-EW-01 — EW deception (MVP range-gate noise), passive ESM emitter linking, EwSpecialist weighting, and EW-state rationale (lines 95-112)

Implement P0 and agent EW beyond noise jamming (SEN-04): P0 range-gate deception/false targets, P0 passive ESM emitter detection linking to contacts, EwSpecialist jamming-vs-kinetic weighting, and P0 agent EW-state rationale citation. SensorModality lacks ESM, EwSpecialist lacks jamming weighting, and deception and EW-state rationale remain open.

- [ ] \[SEN-EW-01\] Deterministic deception / range-gate noise degrades target range/track fidelity in MVP scenarios (full false-target synthesis P1).

- [ ] \[SEN-EW-01\] Electronic Warfare Specialist (EwSpecialist) personality dynamically weights jamming actions vs kinetic fires during decision scoring.
- [ ] \[SEN-EW-01\] Agents cite active EW state in DecisionRecord/AgentDecisionPayload rationale when EW conditions block or alter firing.

### SEN-05 — Datalink side-picture merge, share lag, and CEC composite picture (lines 89-94)

Share tracks across side members via datalink doctrine with configurable lag and degraded-comms behavior, plus Doc 22 CEC composite track netting (SWARM-31). DatalinkSidePictureMerger, DatalinkShareLagResolver, and CecRemoteEngageGate exist, while full degraded-comms fidelity and conflicting-position merge rules remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[SEN-05\] Datalink sharing propagates contacts deterministically with configured share lag and halts or degrades when comms are denied.
- [ ] \[SEN-05\] Multi-sensor track merges resolve conflicting position estimates deterministically with recorded provenance.

### SEN-FOG — Fog of War modes (Full picture, Side realistic, Delegation blind) and briefing label (lines 113-123)

Configure scenario Fog of War mode (Full picture, Side realistic, Delegation blind) controlling player vs agent contact visibility and clearly labeling active fog mode in briefing/HUD. PlayerInfoModel and FogModeLabelBinder exist, while full organic-range player hiding and DelegationBlind divergence remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[SEN-FOG\] Player fog hides unidentified contacts beyond organic/configured datalink range under Side realistic and Delegation blind modes.
- [ ] \[SEN-FOG\] Briefing and C2 top-bar chrome clearly display the active scenario fog mode.

### CMD-08 — Doctrine inheritance and effective policy panel (doc 13) (lines 81-81)

Doctrine panel displays effective ROE, salvo cap, EMCON, inheritance source chain (`unit -> embarked -> mission -> group -> side -> scenario`), and unit override control (`DoctrineInheritancePanelHost`, `DoctrineOverrideCommand`). ### SWARM-14 — C2 unit panel swarm fields (mode, integrity, host, links, sensors/weapons) (Phase B, P1) (lines 169-174)

Partial+ (SwarmUnitPanelProjection.ProjectPhaseB / SwarmPanelSnapshot expose mode, integrity, host, linkState, cecMeshState); lacks primary sensor/weapon summary, composite-track contribution, energy/endurance, Unity UI panel chrome, and map-app6-frame--friendly-swarm USS/atlas rendering.

### SWARM-16 — Swarm formations: cloud, wall/screen, spear, orbit (Phase C, P2) (lines 240-243)

Formations (cloud, wall/screen, spear, orbit) act as soft constraints on member layout and engagement geometry. ### SWARM-17 — Multi-axis auto-split assault (Phase C, P2) (lines 244-247)

Assault may split logical mass across approach axes against a single high-value target when doctrine allows. SwarmAssaultAxisSplitter exists standalone (swarm-c2 PASS), but has 0 production callers in src/ or unity/ and EffectivePolicy/data policies lack a split-doctrine field (AllowSplit).

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### SWARM-10 — Operational modes: Hold, Assault, Screen, Scatter, Rejoin (Phase B, P1) (lines 145-150)

Partial+ (SwarmOperationalMode enum, logged IssueMode orders, Screen host-orbit in Tick(), and Assault axis splitter shipped per swarm-b1); Hold/Scatter/Rejoin lack distinct Tick() kinematics and Mode does not directly alter engagement aggressiveness in MvpEngagementResolver.

- [ ] \[SWARM-10\] Operational mode (Hold, Assault, Screen, Scatter, Rejoin) is logged as an order, visible in projection, and produces distinct Tick() movement posture and MvpEngagementResolver engagement aggressiveness.

### SWARM-14 — C2 unit panel swarm fields (mode, integrity, host, links, sensors/weapons) (Phase B, P1) (lines 169-174)

Partial+ (SwarmUnitPanelProjection.ProjectPhaseB / SwarmPanelSnapshot expose mode, integrity, host, linkState, cecMeshState); lacks primary sensor/weapon summary, composite-track contribution, energy/endurance, Unity UI panel chrome, and map-app6-frame--friendly-swarm USS/atlas rendering.

- [ ] \[SWARM-14\] Selected swarm unit panel (headless + Unity UI) shows mode, integrity, energy/endurance if modelled, host, linkState, cecMeshState/composite-track contribution, and primary sensor/weapon summary, updating live with CMD-17 unknown reasons.
- [ ] \[SWARM-14\] Unity MapPlaceholderPanel.uss and App6FrameAtlas.png.meta implement map-app6-frame--friendly-swarm USS/atlas rendering for SWARM-09 follow-on.

### SWARM-16 — Swarm formations: cloud, wall/screen, spear, orbit (Phase C, P2) (lines 240-243)

Formations (cloud, wall/screen, spear, orbit) act as soft constraints on member layout and engagement geometry. SwarmController.IssueSetFormation stores unit.Formation and SwarmFormationLayout exists standalone (swarm-c1 PASS), but SwarmFormationLayout and GetFormation have 0 production callers in engagement geometry or unity/.

- [ ] \[SWARM-16\] Wire SwarmFormationLayout / GetFormation into production engagement geometry and/or Unity member layout rendering so formation orders constrain layout and geometry deterministically.

### SWARM-17 — Multi-axis auto-split assault (Phase C, P2) (lines 244-247)

Assault may split logical mass across approach axes against a single high-value target when doctrine allows. SwarmAssaultAxisSplitter exists standalone (swarm-c2 PASS), but has 0 production callers in src/ or unity/ and EffectivePolicy/data policies lack a split-doctrine field (AllowSplit).

- [ ] \[SWARM-17\] Add split-doctrine field to EffectivePolicy / scenario policy JSON and wire SwarmAssaultAxisSplitter into production SwarmController / engagement assault resolution.

- [ ] \[SWARM-18\] EMP scatters/freezes mode switches and jamming degrades linkState, order latency, and live CEC mesh membership deterministically.

### SWARM-22 — Scenario editor placement and configuration of swarms (Phase B, P1) (lines 189-194)

Partial+ (ScenarioDocumentEditor.PlaceSwarmUnit/ConfigureSwarmUnit and SwarmScenarioValidation shipped in Data); ScenarioValidationEngine never invokes SwarmScenarioValidation, PlaceSwarmUnit lacks ICatalogReader lookup, and CLI/Unity scenario editor have 0 swarm placement UI.

- [ ] \[SWARM-22\] ScenarioValidationEngine invokes SwarmScenarioValidation on loaded/authored scenarios to catch count > maxDrones, invalid host refs, and missing catalog refs.

- [ ] \[SWARM-23\] Wire SwarmAgentIntentIssuer into DelegationOrchestrator.Tick() / AgentController so delegated agents issue swarm assault/screen orders in production runs with order-log actor attribution.
- [ ] \[SWARM-23\] Implement per-axis or unit-level delegation badges for swarm units matching doc 04.

### SWARM-26 — Contact classification distinguishing hostile swarms (CMD-29) (Phase B, P1) (lines 201-206)

Partial+ (standalone SwarmContactClassifier and SwarmContactLabel shipped in Sim/Sensors/ with unit tests per swarm-b5); 0 production callers in src/ or unity/—PdDetectionContactSimulator and ContactDetailProjection (CMD-29) remain unwired.

- [ ] \[SWARM-26\] PdDetectionContactSimulator and ContactDetailProjection (CMD-29) integrate SwarmContactClassifier to display swarm-class labels with confidence when sensor quality permits and allow misclassification at low quality.

before_state.description:

- [ ] Draft (pending owner): VER-07.1: Every CI gauntlet oracle run uploads baseline-context.json alongside

---

## Goal

Replace fragile, substring-oriented proof as the primary integration mechanism with versioned, typed mission-thread evidence correlated to replay, requirements, and CI results.

## Acceptance criteria

* Defines schema/versioning for relevant contact, authority, data-link, recommendation, engagement, and assessment facts.
* Correlates a scenario run with replay, oracle outcome, Buildkite evidence, and defect follow-up.
* Retains existing fingerprint checks during migration; no silent loss of fail-closed coverage.
* Keeps simulation facts authoritative and observable without duplicating tactical logic.

## Dependency

Requires the capability manifest.

## Revision-bound evidence extension — 2026-09-30

Owner: drg amtd. Requirement VER-07.3–6 (proposed). Every evidence row records requirement/AC ID, inspected and executed revision (and dirty-tree identity), scenario/seed/policy/catalog identity, command or harness, timestamp, artifact link, result and evidence kind (static inspection/headless/Editor capture/human acceptance). Keep declared floor separate from observed counts; historical results cannot satisfy a different revision. Missing, skipped or blocked evidence remains explicit. Owner signoff is a separate row with person/date/revision; technical success never infers acceptance.

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** parent epic [DRG-198](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-198>); blocks [DRG-202](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-202>). The 'capability manifest' dependency has no Linear issue.
* **Decision needed (CMANO):** the capability manifest it depends on is unticketed, and the evidence schema/version format is a design decision.

## Goal

Validate combat quality independently at simulation-truth, decision/authority, and player-presentation layers.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #699)

(1) is deferred by design — #699 is a headless PR; Unity host wiring and Editor screenshots are explicitly out of scope. (2)/(3) only surface once a host renders barks; no live consumer yet.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Strip and bark render in the live commit UI via the existing presentation host; projection-only fence (`CommitStripProjectionFenceTests`) stays green; plugin DLL refreshed; Editor capture recorded.
* One denied order yields exactly one DROPPED bark (correlated `PolicyDenialRecord` + synthetic not-launched `EngagementRecord` coalesced); regression test.
* Fallback abort code (e.g. `UNSPECIFIED`) appears in both bark and log line; regression test.
* Façade remains authoritative; no `SimulationSession` / order-sink / `DelegationBridge` edits from presentation.

before_state.description:

Acceptance Criteria:

- [ ] Add generic-only Warning tier for Patrol/Strike on CLI simulate path

---

Additional Sources: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-requirements-planning-reconciliation.md` (22); `docs/engineering/sim-capability-gap-backlog.md` (26-34)

## Context

Deferred code-review finding on [PR #698](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/698>) (<issue id="044990c3-0fab-4227-988a-c3ca7af56e6f" label="DRG-345" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-345/h4-capability-expose-unsupported-mission-roles-before-export-and-play" /> disclose unexecuted mission roles before Export and Play). Related: <issue id="5f3fde68-82d5-4309-8b80-1254f1308065" label="DRG-346" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-346/h4-first-slice-map-edit-validate-save-export-play-using-existing" /> H4 first slice.

## Finding

`MissionRoleCapabilityManifest.cs:103` **labels Patrol/Strike as executed**, but `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` never passes missions to `BalticReplayHarness.Run`. On the CLI simulate path, Patrol/Strike missions are therefore effectively generic (units behave without mission-specific execution), so the manifest overstates execution.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #698)

The obvious fix — marking Patrol/Strike unexecuted at **Error** severity — would block Export of every Patrol/Strike scenario, which is worse than the current overstatement. The right fix needs a new intermediate tier, which is a contract change beyond #698's scope.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Manifest gains a **generic-only** tier evaluated per execution backend (CLI simulate vs session/Play), surfaced as a **Warning** finding with a stable code.
* Patrol/Strike on the CLI simulate path produce the generic-only Warning; Export and Play are **not** blocked; Tanker/AEW/EW unexecuted Errors unchanged.
* Disclosure text in validation UI/briefing states the role runs as generic behavior on that backend; UI does not invent sim authority.
* Deterministic role-policy fixtures + UI projection tests cover executed / generic-only / unexecuted; saving incomplete drafts still allowed.
* If `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` is later changed to pass missions, the tier flips to executed via the manifest (no hard-coded role lists in UI). ReplayGolden hash untouched.
