The obvious fix — marking Patrol/Strike unexecuted at **Error** severity — would block Export of every Patrol/Strike scenario, which is worse than the current overstatement. The right fix needs a new intermediate tier, which is a contract change beyond #698's scope.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Manifest gains a **generic-only** tier evaluated per execution backend (CLI simulate vs session/Play), surfaced as a **Warning** finding with a stable code.
* Patrol/Strike on the CLI simulate path produce the generic-only Warning; Export and Play are **not** blocked; Tanker/AEW/EW unexecuted Errors unchanged.
* Disclosure text in validation UI/briefing states the role runs as generic behavior on that backend; UI does not invent sim authority.
* Deterministic role-policy fixtures + UI projection tests cover executed / generic-only / unexecuted; saving incomplete drafts still allowed.
* If `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` is later changed to pass missions, the tier flips to executed via the manifest (no hard-coded role lists in UI). ReplayGolden hash untouched.

## Requirement Breakdown & Acceptance Criteria

### AME-6.11 — [Draft / Proposed 2026-09-30] Runtime capability disclosure for offered mission roles (H4) (lines 169-169)

Proposed H4 contract (DRG-345, DRG-346, DRG-333): every offered mission role displays runtime support; unsupported roles block Export/Play while Save remains allowed; CLI and GUI agree. Note: DRG-345 headless MissionRoleCapabilityManifest.cs + MissionRoleCapabilityProjection.cs + tests exist on disk while owner acceptance (DRG-346 H4 gate) remains pending.

- [ ] [AME-6.11] Draft (pending owner): [Draft - owner acceptance pending] Supported/unsupported-role matrix, persisted Save round-trip of unsupported content, rejected Export/Play, identical CLI/GUI finding code/severity, and pre-Play disclosure.

### REC-AME-6.11 — Mission role runtime capability disclosure reconciliation (H4) (lines 22-22)

Every offered mission role exposes runtime support for selected build/scenario; unsupported roles emit stable error on Export/Play while Save preserves WIP; CLI & GUI share domain assessment (DRG-345/DRG-346/DRG-333). Partial subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] [REC-AME-6.11] Draft (pending owner): Table-driven supported/unsupported roles, Save round-trip, Export/Play rejection, identical code/severity across CLI & GUI, no false execution claim.

### GAP-01 — Support mission roles (Tanker / AEW / EW) simulation behaviour (lines 26-34)

Vocabulary-only trap: MissionAddSupportCommand allows Tanker/AEW/EW, but Sim never executes refueling, endurance extension, or AEW coverage (AME-6.11/DRG-345 added Export/Play disclosure gate; runtime execution still absent).

- [ ] [GAP-01] Either implement deterministic support-mission simulation behaviour (air-to-air refueling transfer, AEW radar coverage) or keep Export/Play gated with clear author disclosure until implemented.

before_state.title: Per-category message-log notification policy (log / pause / map balloon / drop to 1x)
before_state.description:
Source: `Game-Requirements/requirements/17-Replay-AAR-And-Order-Log.md` (106; +3 below)
Req IDs: RPL-15, OPS-01, PRD-P1-2, UI-08
Lifecycle: Active; Draft (pending owner)
Notion: [https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df8197a0ebe97257bbe142](<https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df8197a0ebe97257bbe142>)
Acceptance Criteria:

- [ ] MessageCategoryPolicy maps categories to Log/Pause/Balloon/1x via facade.

---

Wiki: [https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc>)

Additional Sources:

* Source: `notion://3f2f7cb4e4df8199aad8f1dd50c6831e` (Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07, 66)
* Source: `docs/product/prd-mvp-ui-2026-07-15.md` (96)
* Source: `docs/product/ui-requirements-brainstorm-2026-07-15.md` (47-55)

## Problem

The message log has no per-category notification policy. In CMO, each message type (new contact, weapon launch, weapon endgame, unit lost, fuel, etc.) can be set to: show in the log, raise a pop-up that pauses the sim, show a balloon on the map at the subject, and drop time compression to 1x. Without this, a player running at high time compression can miss a hostile launch or a lost unit until well after it happens. Aegis has pause and acceleration (<issue id="33bfdfcc-aeed-49b3-b9a5-e2dd6df86193" label="DRG-14" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause" />) and a message log (<issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" />), but nothing links log categories to attention or time-control behavior.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual, Game Options → Message Log: per message type, "Show on Message Log", "Raise Pop-Up" (pauses the game), "Show Balloon" (on the map at the subject's location), and "Timescale X1" (drop from acceleration to 1x). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/>)
* CMO manual §3.1.7: the log is split into categories that can be minimized or emphasized, so routine messages don't bury critical ones. Hovering a message highlights its subject on the map. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* Player feedback asks for exactly this per-type control, including keeping time running while still being notified. [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/](<https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" /> covers click → unit deep-link, and <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> covers sourcing combat lines from CombatEvent. Neither covers category policy or time-control escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageCategoryPolicy` projection maps each message category to {Log, Pause, Balloon, DropToRealTime}. Defaults are data-driven, not hardcoded.
* When a matching message arrives, the projection emits an attention intent. Pause and 1x requests go through the existing command/time façade as player-visible requests. The projection never calls sim internals directly, and the change does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath or SimulationSession.
* The UI binds only to the projection. A settings panel edits the policy, and balloon markers anchor to the message subject.
* Replay is deterministic: under AttachReplayViewer, policy-driven pauses are suppressed or reported but never change the order log.
* Tests cover the default mapping, a user override, and the no-op under replay.

Origin: Projects Manager web research 2026-10-07

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

## Problem

The message log has no per-category notification policy. In CMO, each message type (new contact, weapon launch, weapon endgame, unit lost, fuel, etc.) can be set to: show in the log, raise a pop-up that pauses the sim, show a balloon on the map at the subject, and drop time compression to 1x. Without this, a player running at high time compression can miss a hostile launch or a lost unit until well after it happens. Aegis has pause and acceleration (<issue id="33bfdfcc-aeed-49b3-b9a5-e2dd6df86193" label="DRG-14" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause" />) and a message log (<issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" />), but nothing links log categories to attention or time-control behavior.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual, Game Options → Message Log: per message type, "Show on Message Log", "Raise Pop-Up" (pauses the game), "Show Balloon" (on the map at the subject's location), and "Timescale X1" (drop from acceleration to 1x). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/>)
* CMO manual §3.1.7: the log is split into categories that can be minimized or emphasized, so routine messages don't bury critical ones. Hovering a message highlights its subject on the map. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* Player feedback asks for exactly this per-type control, including keeping time running while still being notified. [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/](<https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" /> covers click → unit deep-link, and <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> covers sourcing combat lines from CombatEvent. Neither covers category policy or time-control escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageCategoryPolicy` projection maps each message category to {Log, Pause, Balloon, DropToRealTime}. Defaults are data-driven, not hardcoded.
* When a matching message arrives, the projection emits an attention intent. Pause and 1x requests go through the existing command/time façade as player-visible requests. The projection never calls sim internals directly, and the change does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath or SimulationSession.
* The UI binds only to the projection. A settings panel edits the policy, and balloon markers anchor to the message subject.
* Replay is deterministic: under AttachReplayViewer, policy-driven pauses are suppressed or reported but never change the order log.
* Tests cover the default mapping, a user override, and the no-op under replay.

before_state.title: [AI-S2-4] Hindsight follow-up: host-side recall adapter and an awaitable finalize beside OnScenarioFinalized
before_state.description:
Source: `Game-Requirements/requirements/07-Agentic-Infrastructure.md` (line 78); `Game-Requirements/requirements/17-Replay-AAR-And-Order-Log.md` (line 122)
Req IDs: INF-2.4, RPL-23
Lifecycle: Active (RPL-23); Shipped-base (INF-2.4)
Notion: [https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df8182b94df38445cbb2fb](<https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df8182b94df38445cbb2fb>)
Acceptance Criteria:

- [ ] Add host-side recall adapter + awaitable finalize; replay unchanged

---

## Problem

`IHindsightMemoryClient` documents retain, recall, and reflect, but exposes only retain and reflect. `HindsightSessionFinalizer.ReflectAarAsync` discards its result and swallows failures, so a completed reflection is never visible to anyone.

The first AAR slice reads the exported evidence file and needs neither fix. This issue is the follow-up.

## Scope

* Add a separate recall interface in the host adapter. Do not change `IHindsightMemoryClient`.
* Add a new awaitable finalize method beside `OnScenarioFinalized` that returns the reflection result.
* Leave `OnScenarioFinalized` and its fire-and-forget teardown behaviour untouched.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Existing Hindsight tests pass unmodified.
2. With the sidecar unreachable, the new method returns an explicit unavailable status and simulation teardown is unaffected.
3. Order-log fingerprints and replay hashes unchanged with Hindsight on, off, or unreachable.
4. Both targets (`net11.0` and `netstandard2.1`) build.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the AAR pipeline. Lower priority than the rest of slice 2.

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

>>> Agent notes

Proposed surface (not a CMANO stamp): recall adapter under `src/ProjectAegis.Ai.Host/Memory/**` (new). The awaitable finalize is an **additive** method in `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Hindsight/HindsightSessionFinalizer.cs`; this is the only issue in the epic that edits an existing shared-project file, so run GitNexus impact on `OnScenarioFinalized` first (older index: LOW, 2 direct dependents) and get a CMANO Surface stamp.

Read-only: `IHindsightMemoryClient.cs`, `HindsightHttpMemoryClient.cs`, `docs/engineering/hindsight-session-memory-sidecar.md`.

>>>

Follow-up from Security scanner and Jev on <pull-request id="9aa03ff2-8ea7-47fd-b894-a85bbee4b7be" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#870" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/drg-766-port-buildkite-ci-onto-github-actions-self-hosted-runners-a0f10fcb16b1" /> (head cd92ee5).

* Verify the downloaded .NET SDK archive with sha512. [dotnet-install.sh](<http://dotnet-install.sh>) is already pinned, but pinning the installer doesn't pin the SDK bytes.
* unity-ci.yml hardening, kept out of #870 because it was gated: persist-credentials: false and a job timeout.
* Any remaining LOW items from Security scanner's #870 verdict.

**Constraints:** draft PR only. No ready, no merge, no workflow_dispatch. Change unity-ci.yml only with Jev's sign-off, and keep replay hash 17144800277401907079.

**Security scanner LOW items at cd92ee5 (verdict PASS-WITH-CONDITIONS):**

1. gitnexus-wiki push (:65). Use the AUTHORIZATION: basic base64(x-access-token:TOKEN) header, not bearer. With enforce_admins on, branch protection blocks a direct push to main, so push a branch and open a PR, or drop the step. The step also still runs an unpinned `npm i -g gitnexus` (:33).
2. Set npm_config_cache to RUNNER_TEMP for the gitnexus tarball install, and consider --ignore-scripts.
3. Pin node exactly in the gitnexus jobs (Node 24), and skip the unchecked download fallback in [agent-bootstrap-node.sh](<http://agent-bootstrap-node.sh>).
4. Vendor [dotnet-install.sh](<http://dotnet-install.sh>) so an upstream update doesn't break the hash check.
5. Remove the redundant setup-dotnet in selfhosted-ci.yml (:51, :110).

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### FR-18 — Command-and-Control UI (lines 153-153)

Provide a headless-first, projection-driven C2 user interface for tactical map, OOB, unit detail, message log, attack menu, and delegation controls per 20-Command-And-Control-UI.md (tracker status: Partial).

- [ ] \[FR-18\] Unity UI Toolkit hosts bind strictly to read-only projections and dispatch commands through bridge queues without mutating sim state directly.
- [ ] \[FR-18\] Remaining map, doctrine, mode, and C2 UX polish completes per 20-Command-And-Control-UI.md.

### OV-NFR-07 — English-Only v1 Localization with Externalized UI Strings (lines 169-169)

Ship English-only at v1 while keeping all player-facing UI strings externalized from day one so future localization is a data task rather than a code refactor.

- [ ] \[OV-NFR-07\] Player-facing UI copy resides in externalized string/i18n tables with zero hardcoded gameplay UI strings.
- [ ] \[OV-NFR-07\] English-only locale ships cleanly at v1.

### OV-NFR-08 — Accessibility v1 Commitments (lines 170-170)

Provide colorblind-safe shape-coded MIL-STD-2525 map symbology (never color alone), scalable UI text, full keyboard operability of command functions, and no audio-only critical cues (screen-reader out of scope for v1).

- [ ] \[OV-NFR-08\] Map symbology distinguishes affiliation and domain via MIL-STD-2525 shapes in addition to color.
- [ ] \[OV-NFR-08\] All command functions are keyboard-operable, UI text scales cleanly, and critical alerts include non-audio indicators.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### DSA-1.1 — Scheduled Daily UTC OSINT Digest Job and Run Summary (lines 33-46)

Run a scheduled daily UTC OSINT digest batch across approved defense/research feeds and persist a structured run summary (sources polled, items found, errors). Headless OsintDigestRunner exists, but scheduled daily UTC execution and run summary persistence remain unproductized.

- [ ] \[DSA-1.1\] Daily digest job completes within configured UTC window and writes a run summary (sources polled, items found, errors).

Support on-demand targeted OSINT queries via CLI/MCP returning structured discovery records (source URL, snippet, timestamp, relevance score) matching the digest schema. Fixture/RSS CLI and MCP bindings exist, while live external defense/arXiv/patent feed search remains partial.

- [ ] \[DSA-1.2\] On-demand MCP search returns structured hits within the same schema as digest items (source URL, snippet, timestamp, relevance score).

### DSA-1.4 — OSINT Discovery Deduplication Against Staging and Live Catalog IDs (lines 40-49)

Deduplicate each discovered OSINT item against both staging proposals and live database canonical IDs before confidence scoring. Current DedupeDiscoveries only deduplicates within a single digest batch.

- [ ] \[DSA-1.4\] Each discovered item is deduplicated against staging and live DB canonical IDs before scoring.

### DSA-1.5 — Rate-Limit/ToS Compliance and Non-Blocking Source Error Isolation (lines 35-50)

Enforce per-platform rate limits and terms of service across OSINT connectors, logging retrieval failures without blocking subsequent digest runs.

- [ ] \[DSA-1.5\] All retrieval respects platform rate limits and ToS; failures are logged and do not block the next digest.
- [ ] \[DSA-1.5\] Digest and on-demand jobs remain idempotent and recoverable after partial failure.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### DBI-2.1 — Consistent Range and Speed Unit Enum Validation (lines 59-67)

Enforce consistent units and scales across systems (ranges in nm, speeds in knots or Mach) and emit explainable ValidationFinding codes when outside allowed unit enums.

- [ ] \[DBI-2.1\] Validation pipeline flags range/speed unit enums outside allowed sets (nm, knots, Mach) with explainable finding codes.

### DBI-2.2 — Sanity Bounds Enforcement (Max Range > 0, Mach <= 25) (lines 60-68)

Reject or flag commits where max range <= 0 or Mach > 25 per configurable validation defaults. PlatformWorkbook damage/HP bounds exist, while general Mach > 25 and catalog-wide range sanity rules remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[DBI-2.2\] Sanity rules reject or flag commits where max range <= 0 or Mach > 25 (configurable CatalogValidationDefaults).

### DBI-2.4 — Human Approval Gate for >10-Record or Balance-Critical Bulk Commits (lines 63-70)

Require explicit human ApproveBatch confirmation for commits affecting > 10 records or any field tagged balanceCritical to prevent silent bulk normalization.

- [ ] \[DBI-2.4\] P0 commits affecting > 10 records or any balanceCritical field require explicit human ApproveBatch (no silent bulk normalize).

### DBI-3.1 — Referential Integrity Validation for Sensor Bindings (lines 73-84)

Fail/warn validation when sensor bindings reference unknown platformId or sensorId. CatalogRulesValidationAgent and KillChainRules reject unknown platformId on PlatformToSensor edges and missing injected sensors, but lack a sensor master catalog to validate unknown sensorId on CatalogSensorBinding (Run returns Passed=True, Findings=0).

- [ ] \[DBI-3.1\] CatalogRulesValidationAgent fails or warns when sensor bindings reference unknown platformId values (currently covered via KillChainRules KILL_CHAIN_ORPHAN_EDGE).
- [ ] \[DBI-3.1\] CatalogRulesValidationAgent validates sensorId on CatalogSensorBinding against a standalone sensor master catalog/registry and fails or warns on unknown sensorId values.

### DBI-3.4 — Quarantined Binding Isolation Until Explicit Promotion (lines 87-87)

Isolate quarantined bindings (sensor_quarantine) from sim export until promoted. CatalogJsonImporter and SqliteCatalogReader isolate sensor_quarantine from live export, but CatalogQuarantinePromoter.PromoteApproved has 0 production callers in src/unity/CLI and bypasses CatalogWriteGate via raw INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sensor.

- [ ] \[DBI-3.4\] Quarantined bindings (sensor_quarantine table) never appear in live simulation catalog exports until promoted.
- [ ] \[DBI-3.4\] Wire CatalogQuarantinePromoter.PromoteApproved through CatalogWriteGate and MissionEditor.Cli (replacing raw INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sensor SQL) with production callers and CLI tests.

Write append-only CatalogChangeLogEntry rows recording actorType, actorId, rationale, ApprovalState, and RevisedUtcTicks per approved batch. CatalogWriteGate writes actor/state/ticks, but ApproveBatch takes no rationale param, AppendEntityChangeLog hardcodes rationale='', and MarkBatchState overwrites catalog_staging_batch.rationale to '' on approval.

- [ ] \[DBI-4.1\] ApproveBatch accepts and preserves batch rationale, and every approved batch writes catalog_change_log rows with actorType, actorId, non-erased rationale, ApprovalState, and RevisedUtcTicks.

### DBI-5.3 — Post-P0 +-8% Win-Rate Balance Drift Flagging Over >= 500 AvA Runs (lines 118-118)

Flag when platform/weapon win-rate delta exceeds +-8% over >= 500 agent-vs-agent runs. BalanceDriftOptions (DBI-5.3: 0.08/500), BalanceTelemetryAccumulator, BalanceDriftAdvisoryConsumer, and CatalogBalanceDriftPipelineEvaluator are shipped, while >= 500-run BalticBatchRunner AvA aggregation and per-weapon batch win-rate tracking remain unbuilt.

- [ ] \[DBI-5.3\] Post-P0: flag when platform/weapon win-rate delta exceeds +-8% over >= 500 agent-vs-agent runs (tuneable).

Preserve all provenance metadata fields (ValueTier, Confidence, CitationRef, ReviewerId, RevisedUtcTicks, TrlLevel, ReviewState) when importing JSON fixtures via CatalogJsonImporter. - [ ] \[DBI-6.2\] CatalogJsonImporter.ReadSensorBindings and WriteSqlite round-trip ValueTier, CitationRef, ReviewerId, and RevisedUtcTicks alongside Confidence, TrlLevel, and ReviewState from JSON fixtures.

ApproveBatch runs validation agents and returns WriteGateDecision.Committed == false on errors. KillChainCommitGate runs on ApprovePlatform/Weapon/MountStaging, but CatalogWriteGate has 0 refs to CatalogRulesValidationAgent/CatalogConsistencyAgent and skips KillChainCommitGate on ApproveSensorStaging and 8 other approval paths.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### ARCH-2.2 — Deterministic Runtime TargetRegistry Register/Unregister (lines 102-107)

Support runtime entity registration and unregistration in TargetRegistry without invalidating deterministic tick order. TargetRegistry currently implements RegisterUnit/RegisterGroup with duplicate-key rejection, while runtime Unregister/Remove support is absent from TargetRegistry and DelegationOrchestrator.

- [ ] \[ARCH-2.2\] TargetRegistry exposes runtime Unregister/Remove alongside RegisterUnit/RegisterGroup without invalidating deterministic tick order or corrupting OOB/projection member lists.

### ARCH-2.5 — Managed Entity-Scale Throughput Target (10k-25k @ 1000x+ / 5k @ 60 FPS) (lines 95-110)

Scale managed data-oriented simulation hot paths (SoA, order-stable reductions, optional SIMD) to meet INF-5.1 measurement targets (10,000 v1.0 / 25,000 @ 1000x+ headless / 5,000+ @ 60 FPS interactive presentation).

- [ ] \[ARCH-2.5\] Post-P0: managed entity-scale path meets INF-5.1 measurement bar (ProjectAegis.Sim.Benchmark); map-symbol rendering scale stays in presentation layer.

### ARCH-4.2 — DetectionSubhash Mixing Before Engagement Hash Mix (lines 148-153)

Mix DetectionSubhash via SimTickPipeline.MixDetectionTick before engagement hash update each tick. SimTickPipeline.MixDetectionTick is implemented while BalticReplayHarness/PdDetectionContactSimulator mix externally via DetectionWorldHash.MixTick + SimWorldHash.Combine; MixDetectionTick has 0 callers in src/ and 0 direct tests in SimTickPipelineTests.

- [ ] \[ARCH-4.2\] SimTickPipeline.MixDetectionTick updates DetectionSubhash before engagement hash mix during simulation ticks rather than having 0 production callers.
- [ ] \[ARCH-4.2\] SimTickPipelineTests (and/or session/harness integration tests) directly invoke SimTickPipeline.MixDetectionTick and assert DetectionSubhash updates LastWorldHash prior to engagement hash mixing.

### ARCH-NFR-2 — Analyzer/Gate Ban on [DateTime.Now](<http://DateTime.Now>) and Time.realtimeSinceStartup in Sim (lines 196-196)

Enforce an automated Roslyn analyzer or CI review gate banning [DateTime.Now](<http://DateTime.Now>) and Time.realtimeSinceStartup inside ProjectAegis.Sim. Zero [DateTime.Now](<http://DateTime.Now>) occurrences exist in Sim today, but no automated analyzer/test enforces the ban.

- [ ] \[ARCH-NFR-2\] Ban [DateTime.Now](<http://DateTime.Now>) / Time.realtimeSinceStartup in ProjectAegis.Sim (analyzer or review gate).

### ARCH-AGENTIC-1 — Shared CLI/Optional-MCP Bindings With Zero Shadow Write Paths (lines 200-212)

Expose architecture authoring and batch workflows primarily via ProjectAegis.MissionEditor.Cli with optional Unity-MCP host wrappers sharing the exact same validation and IWriteGate APIs (plus Phase N attribute scaffolding).

- [ ] \[ARCH-AGENTIC-1\] Any MCP host and headless CLI share the same validation and catalog APIs with zero shadow write path.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### ROE-AGENT-01 — Agent policy compliance, Assisted blocked proposals, Swarm Coordinator WRA proposals, and EW Specialist (lines 103-109)

Enforce policy rules on agents (doc 04): block Policy Snapshot violations, prompt Assisted illegal actions with reasons, let Swarm Coordinator propose WRA bumps via PolicyUpdate, and let EwSpecialist prioritize legal jamming/deception. SwarmCoordinator and EwSpecialist presets exist in PersonalityCatalog, while PolicyUpdate proposal loop and EW prioritization remain open.

- [ ] \[ROE-AGENT-01\] Agent controllers never issue orders that violate the active Policy Snapshot, and Assisted mode surfaces blocked agent proposals with abort reasons before confirmation.
- [ ] \[ROE-AGENT-01\] Swarm Coordinator can propose WRA adjustments via PolicyUpdate subject to player or event approval in Assisted+ autonomy.
- [ ] \[ROE-AGENT-01\] Electronic Warfare Specialist prioritizes legal jamming and deception actions strictly within active EMCON and ROE constraints.

### ROE-08 — Editor effective-policy resolution, contradiction validation, and What-If preview (lines 110-126)

Provide Mission Board doctrine/ROE/EMCON editing tabs with inheritance visualization, contradictory-policy validation (e.g., Strike mission with HoldFire), and P1 editor-only What-If rule relaxation preview. Validation tests and DoctrineInheritanceProjection exist, while Mission Board tabs, contradiction checks, and What-If preview remain open.

- [ ] \[ROE-08\] Scenario validation emits deterministic findings for contradictory policies (such as Strike mission paired with HoldFire ROE) alongside DOCTRINE_RESOLVED provenance.
- [ ] \[ROE-08\] Mission Board exposes doctrine/ROE/EMCON inheritance tabs and an editor-test-only What-If preview disabled in ranked play.

### ROE-MCP — Policy MCP and agentic inspection/override tools (lines 149-157)

Expose MCP/CLI verbs policy_get_effective, policy_set_override, policy_explain_fire, and policy_snapshot_list for editor and authorized agent workflows. None of these verbs exist in ProjectAegis.MissionEditor.Cli.

- [ ] \[ROE-MCP\] policy_get_effective, policy_set_override, policy_explain_fire, and policy_snapshot_list are exposed via MissionEditor CLI/MCP with structured JSON output.
- [ ] \[ROE-MCP\] policy_set_override respects policy legality and logs provenance without bypassing PolicySnapshot immutability.

### ROE-NFR — Doctrine/ROE determinism, O(1) evaluation cache, 5k-unit scale, and localization (lines 128-136)

Guarantee deterministic policy evaluation order, O(1) per-mount policy checks with per-tick caching, 5,000+ units with inherited policies without UI stall, and localized string tables for all FireAbortReason descriptions.

- [ ] \[ROE-NFR\] Headless runs with identical PolicySnapshot, world state, and seed produce identical policy denial sequences.
- [ ] \[ROE-NFR\] All FireAbortReason user-facing strings resolve via localization string tables and 5,000+ inherited units render without UI stall.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### LOG-SWARM-MUN — Swarm mass expendable munitions burn-rate metric and forward reload trucks (lines 47-51)

Track P0 Mass expendable munitions burn-rate metric per mission for near-future drone swarms (doc 09) alongside P1 land-based forward arming and reload trucks with capacity limits (`16-Logistics-And-Magazines.md:47-51`).

- [ ] \[LOG-SWARM-MUN\] Mass expendable munitions burn-rate metric per mission is computed deterministically and surfaced in mission/batch metrics.
- [ ] \[LOG-SWARM-MUN\] Forward arming and reload trucks (land) enforce store capacity limits deterministically (P1).

### LOG-FUEL-CURVES — Per-domain fuel types and throttle/altitude/speed burn curves (lines 52-61)

Model P0 per-domain fuel types (aviation JP, naval) and MVP throttle/altitude/speed burn curves (16:52-61), feeding Joker/Bingo transitions (LOG-03) and ferry/tanker validation (LOG-06 L58/L60). FuelLedger currently uses a single flat \_burnRateKgPerSecond with zero per-domain fuel types or throttle/altitude/speed curves.

- [ ] \[LOG-FUEL-CURVES\] Platforms track P0 fuel types per domain (e.g., aviation JP, naval marine fuel) across catalog and runtime fuel state.
- [ ] \[LOG-FUEL-CURVES\] Deterministic burn rate responds to throttle, altitude, and speed via simplified MVP curves feeding FuelLedger Joker/Bingo transitions (cross-ref LOG-03 and LOG-06 L58/L60 ferry/tanker validation).

### LOG-06 — Editor logistics validation, ferry reachability, and tanker/boat/airbase checks (lines 161-175)

Validate empty magazines, missing strike tankers, airbase capacity, ferry reachability, sortie capacity, and boat embark/sea-state limits at edit/export time. AIR_NOT_READY and ferry checks exist in ScenarioValidationEngine, while boat checks, airbase capacity, tanker advisories, runtime ferry projection, and Data seaState/maxLaunchSeaState DTO wiring remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[LOG-06\] ScenarioValidationEngine emits AIR_NOT_READY, FERRY_UNREACHABLE_FUEL, STRIKE_UNREACHABLE_FUEL, and configurable missing-tanker strike advisories.
- [ ] \[LOG-06\] Export validation checks airbase capacity, boat host embarkation, boat sea-state launch/recovery limits, and embarked capacity.
- [ ] \[LOG-06\] ScenarioMetadataDto (ScenarioDocumentMetadata) and CatalogPlatformEntry deserialize seaStateDouglas and maxLaunchSeaState cleanly for export validation.

### LOG-09 — Boat launch/recovery FSM, host coupling, and davit/well-deck simultaneity (lines 78-103)

Model embarked small-craft lifecycle (Stowed..Stranded), host speed/maneuver coupling during davit/well-deck ops, simultaneity limits (Davit/WellDeck/Ramp), and LogisticsAbortReason. BoatOpsFsm, BoatOpsStateMap, BoatOpsProjection, and SimulationSession.BoatOps ARE shipped, while host coupling, simultaneity limits, and LogisticsAbortReason enum remain open.

- [ ] \[LOG-09\] Boat launch and recovery advance deterministically by sorted craft ID with abort windows prior to waterborne state.
- [ ] \[LOG-09\] Davit and well-deck operations constrain host speed/maneuver and enforce simultaneous launch/recovery capacity limits.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### LOG-10 — Scenario-level scalar sea-state gate for boat launch and stricter recovery (lines 104-113)

Gate boat launch/recovery using scenario-level Douglas sea-state scalar (0-9) and per-craft maxLaunchSeaState/maxRecoverySeaState. ScenarioSeaState, BoatOpsFsm, BoatOpsStateMap, BoatOpsProjection, and BoatOpsPanelHost exist, but ScenarioMetadataDto and [ProjectAegis.Data/Catalog](<http://ProjectAegis.Data/Catalog>) lack seaState/maxLaunchSeaState/maxRecoverySeaState wiring.

- [ ] \[LOG-10\] Launch is refused with BOAT_NOT_READY:maxLaunchSeaState=<N> when sea state exceeds launch limit.
- [ ] \[LOG-10\] Recovery is refused with BOAT_NOT_READY:maxRecoverySeaState=<N> when sea state exceeds stricter recovery limit, allowing craft launched in rising seas to be blocked from recovery.
- [ ] \[LOG-10\] ScenarioMetadataDto and [ProjectAegis.Data/Catalog](<http://ProjectAegis.Data/Catalog>) (CatalogPlatformEntry/SqliteCatalogReader) deserialize and wire seaStateDouglas, maxLaunchSeaState, and maxRecoverySeaState into SimulationSession.BoatOps.

### LOG-11 — Embarked load capacity, stranded craft persistence, VBSS, and SWARM-13 regen (lines 116-132)

Enforce craft embarked capacity limits, transition abandoned waterborne craft to Stranded with order-log entry, track independent fuel (P2), VBSS boarding (P2), and SWARM-13 host regeneration. Embarked overload refusal and BoatOpsFsm.HostDepartWhileWaterborne->Stranded are shipped, while stranded log rows, craft fuel, VBSS, and SWARM-13 coupling remain open.

- [ ] \[LOG-11\] Overloaded craft refuse launch with EMBARKED_OVERLOAD and waterborne craft whose host departs enter Stranded with a logged order-log row rather than silent destruction.
- [ ] \[LOG-11\] Stranded craft track independent endurance/fuel and support VBSS boarding outcomes and SWARM-13 host-magazine regeneration.

### LOG-MCP — Logistics and magazine MCP tools (lines 207-216)

Expose MCP/CLI verbs logistics_get_readiness, logistics_project_sorties, and magazine_get for inspecting unit readiness breakdowns, sorties-until-bingo projections, and magazine stores/counts. None of these verbs exist in ProjectAegis.MissionEditor.Cli.

- [ ] \[LOG-MCP\] logistics_get_readiness, logistics_project_sorties, and magazine_get are exposed via MissionEditor CLI/MCP with structured JSON output.

### LOG-AGENT-01 — Agent logistics compliance, Swarm Coordinator expendable inventory, LogisticsAbortReason takeoff block, and Cautious boat launch-margin refusal (lines 176-182)

Enforce agent-logistics rules (16:176-182): agents respect bingo/WRA with Cautious early RTB; Swarm Coordinator tracks sub-swarm expendable inventory; P0 blocked takeoff emits LogisticsAbortReason enum; P1 boat launch refuses on sea-state recovery limit (BOAT_NOT_READY), with Cautious refusing at launch margin.

- [ ] \[LOG-AGENT-01\] Agents respect bingo and WRA limits, and Cautious agent personalities return strike assets earlier than Normal/Aggressive under identical fuel/ordnance constraints.
- [ ] \[LOG-AGENT-01\] Swarm Coordinator tracks expendable inventory across sub-swarms deterministically.
- [ ] \[LOG-AGENT-01\] Agent takeoff orders blocked by readiness emit canonical LogisticsAbortReason enum values (P0), and Cautious boat-launch agents refuse at the launch margin with BOAT_NOT_READY rather than waiting for the recovery margin (P1).

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### RPL-06 — Portable replay store bundle and periodic verification checkpoints (lines 88-88)

Persist replay store bundles containing scenario file hash/policy id, catalog version, build id, seed, order log, and periodic verification checkpoints. ReplayCheckpointStore and ReplayCheckpoint are shipped for periodic verification hashes, while portable serialized replay store bundles with build/catalog/scenario metadata remain open.

- [ ] \[RPL-06\] ReplayCheckpointStore records periodic (SimTick, WorldHash, LogFingerprint, LastSequenceId) checkpoints at configurable intervals.
- [ ] \[RPL-06\] Exported replay bundles serialize scenario hash, catalog version, build id, seed, order log, and checkpoints into a self-contained artifact.

### RPL-18 — Running totals for platforms lost, missiles fired, and fuel consumed (lines 112-112)

Compute running totals of platforms lost, missiles fired, and fuel consumed from order-log/logistics records. LossesScoringProjection tallies hostile kills, missiles fired, and denials, while own-side platform losses and fuel-consumed totals remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[RPL-18\] Running totals accurately track friendly/hostile platform losses, missiles fired matching MagazineChange totals, and total fuel consumed matching FuelBurn records.

### RPL-19 — Scenario-metadata scoring model and score-change log events (lines 113-113)

Drive scenario scoring from scenario metadata rules and log event-triggered score changes in the order log. Fixed kill/denial batch scoring exists in LossesScoringProjection, while scenario-configurable scoring rules and logged score-change events remain open.

- [ ] \[RPL-19\] Scenario metadata defines scoring rules and event-triggered score deltas append deterministic score-change entries to the order log.

### RPL-20 — Headless batch CSV export for agent-vs-agent runs (lines 114-114)

Run multi-seed headless batches without UI and export CSV metrics (side, score, losses, sorties, magazine burn rate). BalticBatchRunner and LossesScoringCsvExporter are shipped emitting scenarioId,seed,side,score,kills,missilesFired,denials,fingerprint, while losses, sorties, and magazine burn rate CSV columns remain missing.

- [ ] \[RPL-20\] Headless batch runner executes 100+ runs without UI and exports deterministic CSV metrics per run.
- [ ] \[RPL-20\] LossesScoringCsvExporter includes losses, sorties, and magazine burn rate CSV columns alongside side, score, kills, missilesFired, denials, and fingerprint.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### CMD-18 — Domain-appropriate discrete altitude/depth/throttle presets as named commands (lines 91-91)

Altitude/depth and throttle commandable as named doctrinal states per platform domain (e.g., `under_layer`, `creep`, `flank`, `high`) rather than numeric entry alone. `DomainPresetProjection`, `AxisControlPanelHost`, and `AxisControlAndPresetTests` exist on disk; catalog preset backing (doc 06) and end-to-end command dispatch remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-18\] DomainPresetProjection provides domain-specific named altitude/depth and throttle presets for Air, Surface, and Subsurface units
- [ ] \[CMD-18\] Selecting a named preset dispatches a logged command backed by catalog preset definitions and passes Editor verification

### CMD-19 — Per-axis manual/auto delegation control and mode readout (lines 92-92)

Each commandable axis (altitude/depth, throttle, EMCON, sensors) exposes an independent manual-vs-automatic control and visible mode readout without opening a menu. `AxisControlProjection`, `AxisControlPanelHost`, and `AxisControlAndPresetTests` exist on disk; full ADR-010 sim-to-panel per-axis autonomy state and Editor sign-off remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-19\] Each commandable axis displays its independent Manual vs Automatic mode directly in the panel without opening a modal/menu
- [ ] \[CMD-19\] Toggling an axis updates per-axis autonomy state via ADR-010 projection/command boundary and reflects Mixed unit status accurately

### CMD-20 — Map distance scale (nm) and camera altitude readout (Phase A baseline) (lines 93-93)

Phase A map baseline displays a nautical-mile distance scale bar and camera altitude readout at every zoom level. `MapScaleProjection`, `MapScaleHudPanelHost`, `CoverageMapScaleEvaluator`, and `MapScaleAndCycleTests` exist on disk; live camera zoom binding and Editor verification remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-20\] MapScaleProjection computes nautical-mile scale label and camera altitude label deterministically
- [ ] \[CMD-20\] MapScaleHudPanelHost displays updated nm scale bar across zoom changes in Play Mode

### CMD-22 — Top bar scenario date, Zulu time, local time, and remaining duration (lines 95-95)

Top bar renders scenario date, Zulu (`ZULU HH:mm:ss`), local time (`LOCAL HH:mm:ss`), and remaining scenario duration (`REMAIN HH:mm:ss`). `C2TopBarProjection` and `C2TopBarProjectionTests` implement and test these labels headlessly; Unity `C2TopBarPanelHost` binding and Editor verification remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-22\] C2TopBarProjection formats Zulu, local (with UTC offset), and clamped remaining duration labels from scenario epoch and duration
- [ ] \[CMD-22\] C2TopBarPanelHost displays scenario date, Zulu, local, and remaining duration cleanly in Play Mode

Vocabulary-only: ScenarioMissionContactTrigger.MissionCode flows only to MissionTransitionRecord order log with no enum/validation or behavior effect.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### LOOP-01 — Phase 1: Scenario Selection and Force Composition (lines 18-22)

Allow the player or agent to select theater, time period, and force packages (manned platforms, loyal wingmen, drone swarms, submarines, support assets) and assign initial agent personalities and autonomy levels (Phase 1 full C2 surface remains partial).

- [ ] \[LOOP-01\] Player can select a scenario and inspect/configure force packages before entering Phase 2.
- [ ] \[LOOP-01\] Initial agent personalities and autonomy tiers can be bound to units or task forces at setup.

### LOOP-02 — Phase 2: RTwP Pre-Mission Planning with Explicit Begin Execution (lines 23-30)

Enter Phase 2 with the simulation clock paused by default (CMO-style RTwP) for route, sensor, EW, ROE, and agent assignment planning, transitioning to Phase 3 only via an explicit Begin Execution action (headless gate shipped; C2 UX polish ongoing).

- [ ] \[LOOP-02\] DelegationOrchestrator and SimulationSession remain in Planning phase (ticks and orders blocked) until BeginExecution() is explicitly invoked.
- [ ] \[LOOP-02\] Player can plan routes, ROE, EMCON, and agent assignments without time pressure, or optionally unpause if scenario timing requires.
- [ ] \[LOOP-02\] C2 TopBar Begin Execution UX polish completes per implementation-tracker row 02.

### LOOP-03 — Phase 3: Variable Time Compression During Execution (lines 32-32)

Support variable time compression during Phase 3 execution across interactive tiers (1x-10x), accelerated oversight (30x-300x), and headless batch speeds (900x+) while dynamic combat events drive the simulation (also indexed in Functional Requirements summary table lines 53-59).

- [ ] \[LOOP-03\] Interactive execution supports step-free or tiered time compression from 1x up to 300x+ with safe stop/pause controls.
- [ ] \[LOOP-03\] Headless execution supports high-speed AvA progression without losing determinism.

### LOOP-05 — Scenario playerInfoModel and personalityEditPolicy Gates (lines 96-130)

Configure scenario playerInfoModel (fullTransparency/delegationFog/tieredByAutonomy) and personalityEditPolicy (anytime/planningOnly/tieredRebrief). LoopPolicyGate, ScenarioPolicyProfile, and PlayerInfoFilter are shipped, while TieredByAutonomy aliases DelegationFog (no delayed contacts), tieredRebrief sim-time cost is deferred, and CanEditPersonality skips sim-pause.

- [ ] \[LOOP-05\] ScenarioPolicyProfile and JSON loader parse playerInfoModel and personalityEditPolicy with defaults fullTransparency and anytime, and GetLiveOrderLogView filters live HUD visibility without altering DecisionLog.
- [ ] \[LOOP-05\] PlayerInfoFilter differentiates TieredByAutonomy (SemiAutonomous detail and delayed contact updates) from DelegationFog.
- [ ] \[LOOP-05\] LoopPolicyGate enforces sim-pause checks in CanEditPersonality and tieredRebrief sim-time cost policy fields in CanRebriefAgent.

**User story:** As a player, I want to seize, pause, and return a delegated unit from the unit panel.

## AC

- [ ] Take control yields agent immediately; unit shows Human; group member detaches per locked decision
- [ ] Pause suspends intents without clearing tasking; Resume restores
- [ ] Return to agent rejoins/resumes; order-log ControllerChange
- [ ] Disabled under AttachReplayViewer with reason

**Depends on:** DEL-01 badge refresh.

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

First-package control-handoff lane. Reuse delivered controller badges/initial assignment; do not rebuild them.

Acceptance refinement:

* Exactly one active controller after take/return; rejected or repeated commands cannot duplicate orders or log events.
* Distinguish agent pause from simulation pause and from taking direct control.

* Verify group detach/rejoin, retained tasking and pending-human-order behavior.
* Replay/observer refuses mutations.
* Register all supported handoff commands with the <issue id="d224a671-afb7-4ea8-bf7e-84279249c710" label="DRG-348" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348/h6-save-contract-define-complete-same-buildcatalog-save-resume-state" /> input-journal inventory.

- [ ] [HOL-10] Draft (pending owner): Countermanding an unsubmitted proposal via dismiss/reject MUST leave zero mutation in the order log (INF-7.4).

### PRD-P0-3 — Scoped authority handoff, freeze & hold, atomic precedence (lines 76-76)

Atomic handoff at unit/mission/side scope with freeze-and-hold; most-specific wins (side-level handoff preserves explicit unit/mission assignments). Blocked on OQ-1 scoped authority design.

- [ ] [PRD-P0-3] UI-03 / §3.9; given unit explicitly human-held, handing side to AI keeps unit human-held and roster distinguishes inherited vs explicit; headless precedence matrix tests pass.

### UI-03 — Atomic freeze-and-hold authority handoff (lines 89-95)

Handoff card shows scope, current/dest owner, tick; atomic at declared scope with no mixed pending state; preserves last accepted orders, mission, ROE, doctrine.

- [ ] [UI-03] Human-to-AI or AI-to-human handoff preserves last accepted orders and resolves to exactly one accepted or rejected result (headless command-path test).

Architect ACCEPT. REQ-04 Override & Intervention.

**User story:** As a player, I want to seize, pause, and return a delegated unit from the unit panel.

## AC

- [ ] Take control yields agent immediately; unit shows Human; group member detaches per locked decision
- [ ] Pause suspends intents without clearing tasking; Resume restores
- [ ] Return to agent rejoins/resumes; order-log ControllerChange
- [ ] Disabled under AttachReplayViewer with reason

**Depends on:** DEL-01 badge refresh.

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

First-package control-handoff lane. Reuse delivered controller badges/initial assignment; do not rebuild them.

Acceptance refinement:

* Exactly one active controller after take/return; rejected or repeated commands cannot duplicate orders or log events.
* Distinguish agent pause from simulation pause and from taking direct control.
* Inspect and prove the existing suspension/resume/task-retention seam first. If absent, scope a domain-command dependency; UI state must not become controller authority.
* Verify group detach/rejoin, retained tasking and pending-human-order behavior.
* Replay/observer refuses mutations.
* Register all supported handoff commands with the <issue id="d224a671-afb7-4ea8-bf7e-84279249c710" label="DRG-348" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348/h6-save-contract-define-complete-same-buildcatalog-save-resume-state" /> input-journal inventory.

Candidate read anchors: DelegationOrchestrator.cs, Controllers/ControllerSlot.cs, bridge public take/release APIs; candidate UI anchor: unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/RightUnitPanelHost.cs. These are not a Surface stamp. Runtime remains Backlog; GitNexus unavailable while the development laptop is offline.

## Requirement Breakdown & Acceptance Criteria

### AGD-06 — Player Override, Pause/Resume Agent, and Group Detach-Rejoin (lines 53-59)

Source: `Game-Requirements/requirements/04-Agent-Delegation.md` (lines 53-59). Shipped-base in DelegationOrchestrator.cs and DetachRejoinService.cs; unit panel wiring remains Backlog.

- [ ] \[AGD-06\] TryTakeDirectControl immediately yields agent control and enforces exactly one active controller per target.
- [ ] \[AGD-06\] Overriding a group member detaches it via DetachRejoinService, flags group PendingReplan, and emits GroupMemberDetach and ControllerChange log events.
- [ ] \[AGD-06\] Pause/resume agent preserves tasking without order conflicts; future stayAndSuggest mode remains deferred.

### HOL-10 — Player Override & Non-Mutating Countermand (lines 144-147)

Source: `Game-Requirements/drafts/24-Human-On-The-Loop-Authority.md` (lines 144-147). Guarantee immediate player countermand precedence (hold, abort_launch, abort_boat_launch, rtb) via HumanController and zero order-log mutation when dismissing unsubmitted proposals. Draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[HOL-10\] Draft (pending owner): Player override commands (hold, abort_launch, abort_boat_launch, rtb) issued to HumanController MUST take immediate precedence.
- [ ] \[HOL-10\] Draft (pending owner): Countermanding an unsubmitted proposal via dismiss/reject MUST leave zero mutation in the order log (INF-7.4).

### PRD-P0-3 — Scoped authority handoff, freeze & hold, atomic precedence (lines 76-76)

Source: `docs/product/prd-mvp-ui-2026-07-15.md` (line 76). Atomic handoff at unit/mission/side scope with freeze-and-hold; most-specific wins (side-level handoff preserves explicit unit/mission assignments). Blocked on OQ-1 scoped authority design.

- [ ] \[PRD-P0-3\] UI-03 / §3.9; given unit explicitly human-held, handing side to AI keeps unit human-held and roster distinguishes inherited vs explicit; headless precedence matrix tests pass.

### UI-03 — Atomic freeze-and-hold authority handoff (lines 89-95)

Source: `docs/product/ui-requirements-brainstorm-2026-07-15.md` (lines 89-95). Handoff card shows scope, current/dest owner, tick; atomic at declared scope with no mixed pending state; preserves last accepted orders, mission, ROE, doctrine.

- [ ] \[UI-03\] Human-to-AI or AI-to-human handoff preserves last accepted orders and resolves to exactly one accepted or rejected result (headless command-path test).

Acceptance Criteria:

- [ ] [OV-NFR-09] Every controller change, rebind, and agent decision emits an immutable DecisionLog / OrderLog record.
- [ ] [OV-NFR-09] UI hosts read immutable projections and submit commands only through validated bridge queues (C2TopBarPanelHost projection exit tracked below).

---

## Problem

PR <pull-request id="1e443860-106b-409d-ab13-ec351a172305" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#669" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featui-drg-264-contact-list-sortfilter-fog-mode-briefing-label-303bcb7f65f7" /> added `using ProjectAegis.Sim.Scenario` to Unity `C2TopBarPanelHost.cs` and reads `Orchestrator.ScenarioPolicy.PlayerInfoModel` directly (`ResolvePlayerInfoModel`, \~lines 515–518) for fog-mode chrome. That bypasses [ADR-010](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/main/docs/architecture/adr-010-headless-first-command-driven-ui.md>) §3 (presentation consumes read-only projections).

Recorded as [DRG-771](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-771>) §8 item 8 (CMA-32). Owner go (7:40 PM CT Nov 16, phrase **Accept jev's calls**) chose **waive as read-only presentation use** with a **low-priority exit ticket** to route the read through a projection — not an immediate Unity change in the waiver PR.

## Waiver (docs only — this ticket is the exit)

Temporary waiver lives at:

`docs/architecture/waivers/waiver-c2-topbar-sim-read-2026-11-16.md`

ADR-010 status stays **Accepted**; this waiver does not amend the ADR.

## Required fix (implementation)

1. Expose `PlayerInfoModel` (or equivalent fog/info-model field) on a headless projection the top bar already binds (prefer extending an existing top-bar / loop-policy projection).
2. Update `C2TopBarPanelHost` to consume that projection only; remove `using ProjectAegis.Sim.Scenario` and direct `ScenarioPolicy` / `PlayerInfoModel` type use from the host.
3. Keep the path **read-only** (ADR-010 §2–3). No writes into Sim/Delegation; no `DelegationBridge` hotpath, `SimulationSession`, `CatalogWriteGate`, or `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` edits under this ticket unless separately reserved.

## Out of scope until projection lands

* Expanding other Unity → Sim imports (including `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` baseline)
* Amending ADR-010 text/status
* Live Editor-only chrome polish without a projection contract

## Related

* Parent audit: [DRG-771](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-771>)
* Disjoint from [DRG-772](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-772>) (MissionEditor.Cli → [Ai.Host](<http://Ai.Host>) / ADR-030)

## Target Files (pending sprint dispatch)

`unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/C2TopBarPanelHost.cs ; matching projection / binder / *Tests under UnityAdapter or Presentation ; no DelegationBridge / SimulationSession / CatalogWriteGate / MapPlaceholderPanelHost`

## Done when

1. Top bar fog/info-model chrome binds a projection, not `Orchestrator.ScenarioPolicy` from Unity.
2. `C2TopBarPanelHost.cs` has no `ProjectAegis.Sim.Scenario` import.
3. Waiver marked exited with implementing PR link.
4. Headless gates green; Unity MCP noted if Editor/visual proof is required.

Lane E of <issue id="5a2c560b-90fb-4478-a74d-762e659e014c" label="DRG-771" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-771/architecture-compliance-audit-last-10-sprints-cmano-clone" /> follow-ups (docs waiver + this low-priority ticket only). No Unity code in the waiver PR. CMA-32 / ADR-010 §3.

after_state.description:
Source: `Game-Requirements/requirements/04-Agent-Delegation.md` (lines 64-68); `Game-Requirements/requirements/17-Replay-AAR-And-Order-Log.md` (line 81)
Req IDs: AGD-08, RPL-04
Lifecycle: Active
Notion: [https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df81289afbe090c1fa305f](<https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df81289afbe090c1fa305f>)
Acceptance Criteria:

- [ ] [AGD-08] DecisionLog records AgentIntent, PolicyDenial, and rationale payloads for every agent decision.
- [ ] [AGD-08] Player-facing C2 message/voice log surfaces readable explanations for why an agent took or aborted an action.
- [ ] [RPL-04] Every AgentDecision entry in DecisionLog records AgentId, AutonomyLevel, ScoredIntents, Rationale, Personality/traits context, and non-null PolicySnapshotId surfaced in DecisionLogDeepLinkProjection.

---

## Goal

Prove that agent-assisted play remains explainable and honest through availability and failure conditions.

## Acceptance criteria

* Records skill identity, evidence, inputs, output, authority basis, rationale, and simulation time.
* Tests model or skill unavailability, stale data, network partition, authority withholding, and resource conflict.
* Presents the explicit degraded-mode policy; no hidden fallback decision behavior.

## Requirement source

Notion: Agentic Combat Capabilities — AGC-04, AGC-05, and AGC-07.

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** parent epic [DRG-186](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-186>); AGC-04/05/07; related [DRG-203](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-203>), [DRG-406](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-406>) (skill-envelope enforcement).
* **Decision needed (CMANO):** the explicit degraded-mode policy has to be decided before it can be tested; overlaps <issue id="275cf467-f15e-4751-aead-7eae193751e0" label="DRG-203" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-203/add-agentic-resilience-property-and-mutation-testing-campaigns" />.

## Requirement Breakdown & Acceptance Criteria

### AGD-08 — Agent Communication, Rationale Explanation, and Order-Log Feedback (lines 64-68)

Source: `Game-Requirements/requirements/04-Agent-Delegation.md` (lines 64-68). Report key agent decisions, status changes, and clear decision rationale to the player via order logs and optional agent voice/text log UI. Open in Backlog.

- [ ] [AGD-08] DecisionLog records AgentIntent, PolicyDenial, and rationale payloads for every agent decision.
- [ ] [AGD-08] Player-facing C2 message/voice log surfaces readable explanations for why an agent took or aborted an action.

### RPL-04 — Agent provenance recorded on AgentDecision order-log entries (lines 81-81)

Attach agentId, personality/traits, policySnapshotId, and autonomyLevel onto AgentDecision / DecisionRecord order-log payloads. AgentId, AutonomyLevel, ScoredIntents, and Rationale are shipped on AgentDecisionPayload/DecisionRecord, while PolicySnapshotId and Personality remain open (DecisionLogDeepLinkProjection sets PolicySnapshotId=null for AgentDecision).

- [ ] [RPL-04] Every AgentDecision entry in DecisionLog records AgentId, AutonomyLevel, ScoredIntents, and Rationale (shipped spine) plus Personality/traits context and PolicySnapshotId (currently omitted on AgentDecisionPayload/DecisionRecord and projected as null in DecisionLogDeepLinkProjection).
- [ ] [RPL-04] DecisionLogDeepLinkProjection surfaces non-null PolicySnapshotId and Personality provenance for AgentDecision entries matching the active PolicySnapshot at decision tick.
